Peter, people often ask us why we send so many emails. It’s a fair question — because if your inbox looks anything like ours, then we know that it can feel like the sky is falling during **[big fundraising deadlines](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77931358/451906084/296097457?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20240128_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMGQ1NDkzNC0zY2JlLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QWmXBThwKaIexPQliTYsIBOdhfbbxXU_Np9umUOGnlY=)** or news events. And to compete with all that outside spending, we depend on grassroots donations from people like you: People who chip in $10, $25, or even $1 at a time, to emails like this one. | | Dear Freedom Fighters,

Last Monday, I stepped up to chair the Senate Committee on Finance and Commerce (FICO). On Tuesday, I had a chance to briefly address the school choice rally at the Arizona Capitol. I have been involved since the 90s, and wow, we have had such momentum across the country getting additional programs passed and implemented the past few years. On Wednesday, I had a chance to speak during the Senate Committee on Education about my interest in keeping math standards in Arizona high, and then, on another bill to include political affiliation next to the names of school board candidates on the ballot. On Thursday, I filed a ballot referral with the Senate clerk’s office to end child sex trafficking in Arizona. We held a joint press conference between the House and Senate on Thursday afternoon with survivors and non-profit organizations that help survivors of human trafficking. It is time to put child traffickers away in prison for life for buying and selling our minor children. I also started to file legislation I am introducing this session last Thursday and Friday. The deadline in the Senate to file all legislation for this year is on Monday.

This session I am focused on solving issues impacting our most vulnerable population, safety and transparency in our public schools, criminal justice reform, making our public parks safe again, accountability in our elections, banning foreign dollars in our elections, and much more.

Tomorrow, I will be filing a Senate Concurrent Resolution to stand with Texas and 25 other states in supporting Governor Greg Abbott over the federal government. Joe Biden’s dereliction of duty to protect our southern border against the invasion taking place is shameful.

Take care,
Shawnna

I decided to run because I'm worried about the future of our country, and because it's time to put the negativity and chaos behind us.

We have schools that are failing too many of our children. And we have a world on fire, with war in Europe and the Middle East, and a huge and growing threat from China.

And then you look at Washington. We have a Congress that fights about everything and accomplishes nothing. And we have Joe Biden in the White House, making one bad decision after another, when he's making any decisions at all.

With Donald Trump, Republicans have lost almost every competitive election. We lost the Senate. We lost the House. We lost the White House. We lost in 2018, in 2020 and in 2022.

## U.S. Troops Killed in Mideast Attack
Three U.S. soldiers [were killed and dozens were wounded](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGSgyAYBOCnwe53AAWloLjGLtde6SD8RBKUDBCdvP2NV1-7u8U3-3ObbybEsN-_zYa6-jQbW8OBMwOugPdz3zjtETl2DWo2UCm6QY20WfViUUgnRsMUDiht56UbqFxQKeNHwZqgOeU9ZVwxKgQfW2NYJ4VSnXTUO2VJT9GFmnL7SGGvK_r4SQfm1qatiXqt9VVI90X4RPh0nmeb8V0xl6u_kpSjI3xagsMdivkUqGtGhHeBgvkIFmHDbcFc4BliRAcupx3B1Grs85r5lC0WeKTszA4XFygDPhI-NVm71xliDEUOpKf3zYT4J6v__vQbAAD__3RTasE) in a drone attack Saturday on American forces in Jordan, marking a sharp escalation of hostilities in the region. President Biden blamed Iran-backed groups for the attack, the first time U.S. troops have been killed since the Israel-Hamas war began in October. Some House [Republicans criticized Biden](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGTsyAQgOFfo906CGqkoPgau3ztlc4KS9wEIQMk3v37m7v66rd55_m4rlfkwPH2Hw8y1acVbeU3rT1IDXJYh9YZTyRJtWT6i5hGddGzaHfjnFNEbkK1Oa3VbK0fCWca5eZ8r0XLRgo5iF7qXoyjnDvEXk2j1mpywjttm0GQ45pyd08c604-fKU35c6mow1mr_VZGvWvkUsjl_M8O58-I53lpzdyeZVGLjZzZVsgYNkhvSps7CgC-koZsFa0D3hwCAUUvAoUym-2BAcdG-UC95QdRti5AmeMENPZZuOeJ4fAZbo0g7gdyOF3qf4J9B0AAP__dlZqzA) for letting Iran get away with continuing attacks. U.S. officials [issued a warning](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO6yAQheGnwR0WDNiGguI27nLbLa0JjJPJYhNhFCtvv8rW253iSJ_0f12WC3Lm_fYfNwptLQvGxi9atAQvwS62S2ElAjIdBT2pcTCTd6q7B0zkvMPBXE284oRknLYqTpBWQhzXjgMosEqD12oYwPWI2oyD92ZMak0-CqsocSu1fxTe253W_C4vqn0sW5fDvbXnIcw_AbOA-TzP_lkyN47lcxAw73QeAuaPImBW-rOdgBk3qhxxP-Q350xJPkpNuEuuuMvjXRmlUto4sKarIT1PzpmPcRJW3Tbk_Ou3P2v8BAAA__8Gg19K) to the militant group: _" We will respond in a time and place of our choosing,"_ Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin said.
## House GOP Readies Mayorkas Impeachment
House Republicans released two articles of impeachment against Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas, charging him with a ["breach of the public trust"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O5CAQhJ8GZ20B_g8cXOJsLr3QakN74BaMBT1jzduvvPFmpSqp9On791gf6IM_nn8x0sx7WtGwf9OqQE-g27Wt7LwTaWoqmtUg-64ZplFWbp5Ua8hIMyiLQ9Pt2G846tEo225jb_rKz1rqVio9Kdl1eqwRVdN309T0Vu52MqKVZD2nXP9P_mBHe_ikN-XapFiF2TGfRTR_hF6EXq7rqs2xmXsUermvhV6kuvMo9OLSqxA80wmZAmGhAj6ehMZFOhgwszfhLg_YvAVOkF6FwaVIAQ8Lhcwre_4UiPhJ-QsL3CzAjmBL2VKuHcdQ5dmelw_Bl34QrXxG9OEHmH_V9x0AAP__j0hzaQ) over the failure to secure the U.S.-Mexico border. Impeachment of a Cabinet member is a rare step, and it's happening over the protest of Democrats, who say Mayorkas hasn't committed the "high crimes and misdemeanors" necessary for impeachment. The House Homeland Security Committee will mark up the resolution Tuesday, saying Mayorkas has [refused to enforce immigration laws](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy6yAQAL8GOjynA0mmoHiNOr82pYaBw1wCQiMRe_z3GadOvbNb7MdtvXkuvN3_-0qup7b60PlB66DQKjSrkdElIiQtyQ0zTKOe7RVkdghzDPN1RpzGZMcJwaCOZBBiQKQk2SGggQHtAOOI14v3g55Ga_UUIUUbhAGK3Ntx-Wy89UypvNqDjktoVRaXe99Pof8JXAQuPVPmUt5M4JJbpY2ep8DFGG0G0Cq375PUve2q-lc7vvypuO7kQ660deWPzqHQ25CHi_uTS-FzmoWBe_X8G5b9zwU_AQAA__9gZlyl). House Speaker Mike Johnson pledged to take it to the House floor "as soon as possible."
## Chiefs, 49ers to Meet Again in Super Bowl
And then there were two: The San Francisco 49ers will play the Kansas City Chiefs in the [Super Bowl on Feb. 11](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LuOpDAQheGngayQb1wcEGzSWW-6ISpMuV07xkbY06jfftQdT_5J5-j_d1_uyJHT4y_uNFefF3SVn7RIUBaUWUy7zZ5IkW5plqMYej3aSbRhJmtN77WkcVql0MLhOjnRi3GwWiu3tjwroYyQykrR92rqEKUeemv1sAm_WdcYQRvXfHb_M6cayMdXftLZuby3cQ61HqXRfxp1a9StHPmspXthyPkNGnW7AiXgAjUQlO-DTljzFeG9CiFfUDNcWF34gC9MBQs4ri9wgckXeBYomMCfmBwXl8FYOgskH8EF3A_OqQQ-4IE7gdBSGquM7kLdY3vO23FxjFyGsTHisSPHz-_6a8WfAAAA__-uFnSj)--a rematch of the 2020 Super Bowl that the Chiefs won. The 49ers won the NFC championship [with a big comeback](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAQRp8Gd1gw4B8KipvCXW67pTU2Q8wKGwtIrLz9Kltv90mfjnR0vu7zHUMMx-M_7mSrTzOuNbxolhwMBz3rxllPBKQasnIQfacGM4pms6iNJPAdLIrk2KMYlR9Xo92iDKxiaIIFAVpIMFJ0HYwtolR9Z4zqnfDOrEwLcqGm3H6ncNSNfHynF-V2TXsT7VbrWZj6x2BiMF3X1e7l-HwMJjr4szCYyply_YzDRwbT-czuzbWhXHjGGN-8Jr4QVh5DOgrPhOvGy_OkzJd0fRDM_HaT27noscnWnVeIMZR-YFo8dgzxV6b-meYnAAD__-pYZQ0) against the Detroit Lions; they were down 24-7 at halftime but scored 27 straight points in the 2nd half to get the win. Earlier Sunday, the Kansas City Chiefs won the AFC championship, [defeating the Baltimore Ravens 17-10.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLuO2zAQAL9G6mjw_ShYpHHntCkFarm0NqBEQSRs3N8ffPWVg2kG8--xPBJVOp5_045xlLYkGPTCRTAZmNSLnnMsiBLVjFE4bo1ywfN5iwA-KWW90s6univgwgCahNo7jrjOFCWXmgsZBDdG-ltKQlkTgrKZlxxg0hwzjXbd_jc6xoalfrUXXjdo-1zjNsbZJ_VnkvdJ3tN54Lt_1AeuQVBxknfYCEtnV3rh0VmHdiFLBRhsaT-pHX2jk8nssgatCvoCVuhVurWYAq5oDDqL-Yr5fFOt1K2bNH_uiepPxfj1yXcAAAD__0_FYk0) Kansas City's Travis Kelce had 11 catches for 116 yards, setting a new NFL record for most catches in the post-season. Perhaps the most surprising play in either game was a pass thrown by Ravens' quarterback Lamar Jackson that he caught for a 13-yard gain. subject: urgent ballot for Pro-Life Friend!
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I’m shooting you this quick email because I haven’t seen your name come through yet on our Supporter Ballot.

If you've already filled out your ballot, then you can ignore this message and thank you.

But if you haven’t yet done so, then please fill out your Supporter Ballot immediately!

And once you’re done, please consider making your most generous contribution to Students for Life Action to help us avert out budgetary shortfall [https://secure.studentsforlifeaction.org/ballotpage?src=hf&msgid=240128].

Thanks for all you do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

President, Students for Life Action

Students for Life Action Supporter Ballot Kristan, in order to keep your most critical operations running with limited resources, as a Students for Life Action supporter, I advise you to:

• STOP TURNING YOUNG PEOPLE AGAINST ABORTION [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240128]

Preserve your resources by cutting back on turning young people against abortion – even though young people are set to play a critical role in 2024;

• STOP FIGHTING STATE BATTLES [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240128]

Preserve your resources by easing up on fights against the Abortion Lobby at the state level, including fights against radical abortion referendums;

• STOP YOUR VOTE PRO-LIFE FIRST CAMPAIGN [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240128]

Preserve your resources by ending any and all efforts to get voters to pledge to vote pro-life first – even though it will be crucial to your efforts to elect pro-life leaders across the board in 2024;

OR – IF YOU’D LIKE US TO MAKE NO CUTS. . .

• RAMP UP ALL OPERATIONS. GO ALL-IN! [https://act.studentsforlifeaction.com/students-for-life-action-supporter-ballot-240125/?src=hf&msgid=240128]

Keep all your critical life-saving and mind-changing programs from campuses to Congress running at FULL BLAST in the critical 2024 Election Year!

Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWk5Bl-iGN

ACI - Religious Liberty Survey

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWk5Bl-iGN

Fellow
American,

There is
a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me
worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the
Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and
signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only
intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Are you
concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our
founding-Religious Liberty?

In
addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous
examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v.
BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL
RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few
examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to
faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to
their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act,
brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal
Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and
organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex
marriage failed.

This has
the potential to only intensify legal persecution against
individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to
faith-based values.

The
American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to
preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation
for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty,
Community, and Life.

Whether
it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield
after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a
cake that violates his religious values, are you concerned as I
am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?

Please
share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning
religious liberty in America.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/62744298:Wk5Bl-iGN:m:3:2532013465:B30FE073C568424F419DA97C1364A5C3:r

Thank you
for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder &
Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Your
donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and
preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our
country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods
to decrease the federal government's role in society and to
improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: Moment to talk?
body:
I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zu96i65id6kr4ncngcbkn1at22cif7mtijboikng_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs)
---

Friend,

Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkmou657iubmdm7rloe23dc19kqgh8dov6k9hg50_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2b0kna8h0i2sqgqpo5qhapmoj0090tqudgj6ocg_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf78gvkgqlsudala5odot59nk3uaojogo6pgulao_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1lampis65ke1ekpb5jmakmiucjtbdk8ne7fdde8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs)
---

Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person _reading this today_ could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2m6oh2l50sa2sbl4675005dcgl4llutfhu1qqeo_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z59tksa4vurj6pbsd4hh5eiuga9nt67blsue6sd8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?")**

---
| | [RUSH SUPPORT TODAY](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z85ut9v874n0lgkojdjf8c93uaq4bkvs4aa6av7g_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs)
---

Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help- starting right now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zchb5e8isiggtrahq7jsqlkrh3u27rabfprv9qvg_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs "I need your help – starting right now. ")**

Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs9drm4n2798nnqsfdv6hp7b8vr8da8rmjilfrjo_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs)

Nikki Haley

---

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrficb2ms8gprvfb3optfuultbpa5vpaei18kfag_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs "NikkiHaley_Merch")
---
| | [GET YOUR HAT NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp2ufu5ve8n59lvf10g5cbkeg5mfjidhnb6pojq8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs "Claim Your Mug")
---
---
| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze6126r74j728r8fs2u8p1bra9s7o6lu774o4la8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zttb8cpm9mjl4in5g2is83tqace9tpak90crt3ao_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clgm1o30chh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

He happily pushed Trump's dangerous agenda all throughout his chaotic administration. And after Trump lost the 2020 election, Rick Scott supported his totally baseless claims of voter fraud. **He even voted to overturn the election results**.
Rick Scott is a MAGA extremist through and through: He wants to raise taxes on working families while the top 1% like himself get a tax cut. He wrote the plan to END Social Security and Medicare. He supports a nationwide ban on abortions. He even built his fortune of millions through shady business practices — just like Trump.
It's no wonder that Scott full-heartedly endorsed Trump's reelection campaign. **And now, Trump has fully thrown his support behind Scott, giving his campaign a major boost.**
A man like Rick Scott has no place in the United States Senate. **And with polling data showing our race is tied, we have a real chance to defeat him.** But Scott spent $64 million to buy this seat the last time around, and he's ready to do it again this year. If we want to beat him, we have to hit _every single goal_ between now and Election Day.

# What True Representation Should Look Like

Peter- what does it mean to be a true representative?
While embarking on this journey for Congress, I've encountered moments that define what being a true representative truly means.
[**One such instance unfolded during the 2022 election season when I faced a challenging debate hosted by a far-right group. Watch the video below to hear my story:**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=0d3eefa6f7&e=a2a46ff12c)
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=b33e15b9e4&e=a2a46ff12c)
This experience underscored the essence of listening, a quality integral to genuine representation.
The tough questions and contrasting viewpoints presented pushed me to truly hear the concerns of all constituents.
So, what does it mean to be a true representative? It means listening, learning, and embracing the richness of our district's voices. I may not have all the solutions, but I'm here to listen to you, to learn from you, and to lead with your concerns at the forefront.
[**Let's shape a better future together—one where every voice is heard and every concern is acknowledged.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=1cedf1fed3&e=a2a46ff12c)

name: American Defense News
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z69hdc7ma5u3kdml8nmhkc7q8c7sumq6oadt9ps8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clim8pj0clh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zotrcass0atstf609t1gja3qrd7k9cs32fhud6r8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clim8pj0clh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2znfinv21156ijlpj42hvr7plkhmap9dn118bpb8o_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clim8pj0clh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Can I get your thoughts on religious liberty in America?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsCTTV-iNT

ACI - Religious Liberty Survey

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osCTTV-iNT

Fellow
American,

There is
a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me
worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the
Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and
signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only
intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Are you
concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our
founding-Religious Liberty?

In
addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous
examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v.
BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL
RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few
examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to
faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to
their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act,
brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal
Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and
organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex
marriage failed.

This has
the potential to only intensify legal persecution against
individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to
faith-based values.

The
American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to
preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation
for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty,
Community, and Life.

Whether
it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield
after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a
cake that violates his religious values, are you concerned as I
am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?

Please
share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning
religious liberty in America.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/62745219:sCTTV-iNT:m:3:2627245898:361605ED3F8A1E332D34DA32A2625824:r

Thank you
for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder &
Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Your
donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and
preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our
country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods
to decrease the federal government's role in society and to
improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

name: Matt Hennessey, Campaign Manager
subject: Why my boss, Elissa
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1076%2E135344%2Eda5s51)

Hi there, my name is Matt.
I wanted to take a quick moment to introduce myself. I’m Matt Hennessey, Elissa’s campaign manager, so it’s my job to make sure that we do everything in our power to make her Michigan’s next Senator.
I wanted to put together this note because I’ve been working for Elissa for a long time. I started working for her in the 2020 election cycle, her first re-election campaign to the House of Representatives. It was a tough race, right in the middle of COVID, but a race that we won – making Elissa one of just seven House Democrats to sit in a seat also won by Donald Trump. After that, I headed to DC to work in her congressional office, serving as Elissa’s Chief of Staff. And last year, I officially joined the Senate campaign team as campaign manager to elect Elissa to the Senate.
In politics, it’s common for staff to jump around from candidate to candidate, switching states and campaigns each cycle. I am proud of the fact that Elissa’s team is different – many of our staff have been around for years. And that’s because of our belief in Elissa, and in the mission.
I count myself as one of the very fortunate in that I’ve had the opportunity to get to know Elissa really well, make tough decisions with her, and witness her leadership. And although we’re going to spend the next 281 days traveling the state of Michigan and meeting as many of you as possible, most folks probably won’t have the privilege of knowing her as well as I do.
So let me tell you about Elissa.
Elissa is not only brilliant, she does her homework and always comes prepared. She’s open minded, and encourages people around her to challenge her and always ask for the “why” in doing things. She works harder than anyone else and sets high standards for herself and those around her. She’s deeply principled and believes in public service and the mission to her core. She is precisely the person Michigan needs making tough decisions when the chips are down–which is why I know she will be an excellent Senator for the state. (She has also been known to swear like a sailor and share puppy and animal-related social media content with the staff, but I digress.)
The other reason I’m in your inbox is because a big part of my job is to raise enough money to compete in this race. And I’ll be honest—we’ve never had to raise this much money, even in our tough previous races. This is going to be one of the most expensive Senate races Michigan has ever seen, and orders of magnitude more expensive than our 2020 House race.
[**So, as one of the people who knows her best, will you help us send Elissa to the Senate?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-jan24.--Kpen&refcode=em240127-1-30&t=2&akid=1076%2E135344%2Eda5s51)**

body:
Did you know the United States has a human rights issue in common with countries like China and North Korea?

| [ ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6gjq0cj52pp4b9is5ck7ha3lsljrg567mifetg8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clim2o76cph2bs)

Fellow American,

Did you know the United States has a human rights issue in common with countries like China and North Korea?

**Becuase of the Biden Administration's commitment to the abortion industry, the United States is 1 of 7 countries in the world that allows abortion-on-demand.

** Abortion-on-demand is the ending of an unborn child's life and _ANY_ point of a woman's pregnancy. A baby, fully developed at 38-40 weeks, an be aborted should its mother detemine she does not want her child.

**This is an appalling tragedy happening in our country today and there are many abortionists willing to carry out this barbaric practice celebrated by Big Abortion.

** My heart breaks for the complete devastation and the utter devaluing of human life our own president and his administration is sworn to protect.

These abortion extremists have yet to name a single protection they would grant any unborn child and put it into law. In fact, they want to make abortion-on-demand the law of the land and write it into our own Constitution!

Babies in the womb are screaming in pain because they are being tortured to death and no one can hear them. They have no voice to cry out when they are viciously murdered.

**[We must cry out for them _now_.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zearhbb85qfrh3mcs3vtemgf28uf1h0t898chj9o_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clim2o76cph2bs) **

Stand with SBA Pro-Life America on the front lines in the fight for life and let the Biden Administration know you stand with the majority of Americans and do not support this deadly agenda. Join 72% of Americans who want pro-life protections for babies who can feel pain at 15 weeks in the womb.

Submit your name at the link below and put an end to abortion-on-demand in our country _today._

[SIGN YOUR NAME](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zn0r65abdod5c1jbjnnj54t16d2dna3sgf0732io_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clim2o76cph2bs)
| We must be the voice for the unborn because our president and his administration have proven they will not protect these innocent children.

Do you know how important you are to this?
#

Peter, I want to make sure you know how important you are to this campaign.

Fellow American,

Did you know the United States has a human rights issue in common with countries like China and North Korea?

**Becuase of the Biden Administration's commitment to the abortion industry, the United States is 1 of 7 countries in the world that allows abortion-on-demand.

** Abortion-on-demand is the ending of an unborn child's life and _ANY_ point of a woman's pregnancy. A baby, fully developed at 38-40 weeks, an be aborted should its mother detemine she does not want her child.

**This is an appalling tragedy happening in our country today and there are many abortionists willing to carry out this barbaric practice celebrated by Big Abortion.

** My heart breaks for the complete devastation and the utter devaluing of human life our own president and his administration is sworn to protect.

These abortion extremists have yet to name a single protection they would grant any unborn child and put it into law. In fact, they want to make abortion-on-demand the law of the land and write it into our own Constitution!

Babies in the womb are screaming in pain because they are being tortured to death and no one can hear them. They have no voice to cry out when they are viciously murdered.

**[We must cry out for them _now_.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7sus1hgm03sqlresdio47k669irvjjapl11afg8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33clim2o76cph2bs) **

Stand with SBA Pro-Life America on the front lines in the fight for life and let the Biden Administration know you stand with the majority of Americans and do not support this deadly agenda. Join 72% of Americans who want pro-life protections for babies who can feel pain at 15 weeks in the womb.

Submit your name at the link below and put an end to abortion-on-demand in our country _today._

# Take your Health Back!
Alright, everybody, strap in because I've got something absolutely mind-blowing to share with you, especially all my folks in California and the surrounding areas. This is not your average health benefit – we're talking about a game-changer! Now, I've been through the wringer when it comes to health. Yeah, I shed a whopping 500 pounds recently, but guess what? The battle's far from over. My body's still screaming in pain, and I'm staring down the barrel of two knee replacements. Back and hips? They're on a constant pain playlist, and the list of issues just keeps growing. So, what do you do when the traditional pharmaceutical game doesn't cut it? You dig deep, you research, and you look for alternatives. And let me tell you, my skepticism led me to a revelation that's going to blow your minds!
About a month back, my buddy of 20 years, Pastor James Fortune, hit me up with news that changed the game for him and his wife, Canada. They discovered a treatment so good, it sounds too good to be true. But hold on – it's legit! We're talking medical documents, x-rays, blood tests – the whole nine yards. I practically dragged Pastor James Fortune to Los Angeles because I knew you needed to hear this. We're hosting him at not one, but two locations in LA County. Picture this: an amazing catered dinner on us, and all the info you need to make educated decisions about taking charge of your health and living your absolute best life right now. Don't procrastinate until your body breaks down even more. It's time to restore your youth, break free from the pain, and live the life you've been dreaming of. This is your shot, my friends – seize it! Scan the QR Code on the Graphic to register. Register your friends and come enjoy a meal. Pick Beverly Hills or Torrance

I hope this message finds you well. Building on the recent triumph of our amazing President Donald Trump in the Iowa Caucus, I am thrilled to share the news of securing the highly esteemed endorsement from the California Republican Assembly.
It is indeed an honor to be aligned with like-minded conservative Republicans who share our mission to Save the Nation. Our commitment extends to restoring the nucleus family, preserving parental rights, safeguarding the right to life, and securing our borders for a stronger future.
Amidst the overwhelming support, I am delighted to announce the upcoming release of my own Voter Guide. As individuals from all corners of the nation seek guidance on their voting decisions, this guide aims to provide clarity and insight into the candidates who resonate with our shared values.
For a more interactive engagement, I invite you to connect with me on social media through the links below. Your active participation and support are crucial as we work together to preserve the principles that define our beautiful nation.
Additionally, if you are in the South Bay, I extend a warm invitation to a candidate event on January 22nd. This gathering will provide an opportunity for meaningful dialogue and collaboration. Further details are outlined below.

## 66th Assembly Central Committee
---
|
---
Dear friends and fellow Conservatives,
I am thrilled to announce that I am running for an official seat on the 66th Assembly District Central Committee. As some of you may know, I have been serving as an alternate on the committee for some time now. Over the past two years, I have also been actively involved in multiple posts within the party. I am proud to have been elected to the California Republican Assembly state board of directors as the Senate director for the 24th District, chaired the Faith Outreach committee for the CRA, and served as a delegate for the California State party. These experiences have given me a deep understanding of the values and principles that are important to our party and have prepared me to effectively represent our district on the central committee.
As a member of the central committee, I will work tirelessly to ensure that conservative values remain at the forefront of our party's agenda. I believe that my position on the LAGOP, which is the largest Republican party office in the nation, will allow me to have a greater impact on decisions that affect our party and our community. I have already been able to influence many decisions as an alternate, and I am confident that I can make an even greater impact as an elected member.
While some have urged me to run for the congressional seat of the 36th district, I believe that my calling is to bring balance to the party for the next few years. This will not only benefit the party but also other candidates and myself in the long run. Federal races can be expensive to operate, and I have learned from my previous run for Congress that it takes time to build relationships and secure the support needed to win. My goal is to help fix the foundation of the party while building relationships with those who can help me in the future.
I am asking for your prayers and support as I take this important step on my journey. Please look for me on the primary ballot on March 5, 2024. Early voting begins on February 24, 2024. Your vote for me, Derrick R. Gates, for the 66th Assembly Central Committee, will help ensure that our conservative values continue to be represented in our district and beyond.
Thank you for your support and dedication to our party.

body:

And so, yet again, it is up to us to remind them of their own party’s platform and their own promises, and what is right and good for our country. Below is the call to action, but before you make your calls,**please _[read through this background information](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979467b8957c/1edb97946796d1a6 "read through this background information")_** and details about the bill provided to us by our friends at [Immigration Accountability Project](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979467b8957c/1edb97946796d1a8 "https://iaproject.org/"). **Note that it is key to also tell them to pass H.R. 2. We don’t just want to stop this bad bill. We want them to understand that H.R. 2 is the REAL DEAL and that’s what we _do want_.**
**** Thank you and please share this call to action on social media and pass it on to likeminded friends! In liberty, Jenny Beth Martin ************

Well... when I think about manhood, I think about courage. And that’s not something you can give speeches or write a book about.

Peter, Max Miller really wants to force our campaign to spend all of our money our money right out of the gate. If you haven’t heard, we have a primary challenge. But the challenger isn’t who you’d expect. Our primary opponent
* Voted in multiple Republican primaries but no Democratic ones.
* Donated $4k in GOP federal races and $500 in Ohio House races
* Chaired a panel during the 2016 RNC.
* Praised Bernie Moreno, Max Miller’s father in law who is now running for Ohio Senate against Sherrod Brown with a far-right platform.

If this guy was once a Republican who was horrified by Trump and switched parties I would not shame him at all. **But that’s not the case.** He’s been active in Republican politics up until very recently. **So why is an involved Republican running in the Democratic primary?** The likely answer is to force us to spend money. Apparently Max is scared! Max knows we came incredibly close to beating him last election and is paralyzed by fear that we’ll finish the job this time. Even though TTV’s challenges “utterly lacked reliability” and “verge[d] on recklessness,” the Court did not order TTV to stop its challenge activity in the 2024 election cycle and beyond.
This is not the outcome we sought when we took True the Vote to court for alleged voter intimidation — and it makes our ongoing work fighting back against mass voter challenges even more critical.
**Absent court-ordered relief, voters will continue to rely on groups like Fair Fight and our partners to navigate mass challenges and be able to access the ballot box freely and fairly.** That’s why we will not and cannot back down from the fight against ongoing attempts at voter suppression and intimidation. body:
They don't want to solve this problem, they only want it as a political issue.

Friends —
We need to talk about the issue of immigration and border security in this election — and specifically, what complete and total frauds Republicans are.
They don't want to solve this problem, they only want it as a political issue.
On Joe Biden's first day in office — not his second, not his tenth — he put forward a comprehensive plan on immigration and border security.
Now you have a bipartisan group of Senators who are working out a deal, and the second Trump says "Kill it," the pathetically weak Republican Speaker rolls over and says, "yes sir."
Please watch this short clip:
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/3138?t=1&akid=1798%2E4767699%2EXXyu7_)
We have to take the fight to Republicans on this issue. They are complete and total frauds. They don't want a solution. If they did, we could have one.
Gavin Newsom

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

The truth of the matter is that stories like mine don’t usually make it to the Senate. The average U.S. Senator is 64 years old and a multi-millionaire. It’s time we change that. We should all be able to look at the Senate and see ourselves reflected. And that’s why this grassroots movement means everything to me. Our stories deserve representation. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.

Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. Friend,

Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=831caad836c3409c9dc081a5eb097c7f&_e=ge4m_r1Jc7eRIh3SUR2wDHyT7XQFUDw0LFEzyzSQQft2B6G2-8c4lJcfsPyOe2U5NjweMKUYWeVVitviBpC5-2j72gXE3lcEQ2APnXGoI3is0bKRppSaiWcFwRQjnKmjnDKu7LDBhqjrJgYLlrlSCwDcDojhMB5nH_pTOFkPtKP5FQFIDSMmmkEsU0DXmOXxuOjjslgI093nZVtW21v6jTLHTrPPdfDSAwFGEN2Baiiy6cR1AMjd8E4UC2VWvDSnqOGv6EARukFyctWLEgreYK1wDSLRId5ONCrIn0fg8szDxGqayaGm0Bmra_jjTIcbRtop-qliFhWeI60LRLgOccUqdWU3hGhGjkPvRSgWqGJMx051LpQiwP3nvgo9ySllto4luE1IgU96jZpzUaTZga4RWRMN-13DqRXVup6iblS-kcPhAd-uKM3CAcPT7MjOJZlidSB6rRWQcAOxHANkrhKvxj5j4CK1GWxp11yoCnlZUgZnPM5EKoBV_D8Pvt0lGBa8gpJOQHJZ9vdWHKM6g66pbVLLo-6sSVD_oHMAJN-f35_YuvG6cBuyGIT84iyo_jRXGjCSdm8tk3Iapsb0XnkWm7m6m36GWN2qmVKtxkPNkoT_Zu44Ja5-mIrivBVz "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
---
| | | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=831caad836c3409c9dc081a5eb097c7f&_e=ge4m_r1Jc7eRIh3SUR2wDHyT7XQFUDw0LFEzyzSQQft2B6G2-8c4lJcfsPyOe2U5NjweMKUYWeVVitviBpC5-2j72gXE3lcEQ2APnXGoI3is0bKRppSaiWcFwRQjnKmjnDKu7LDBhqjrJgYLlrlSCwDcDojhMB5nH_pTOFkPtKP5FQFIDSMmmkEsU0DXmOXxuOjjslgI093nZVtW21v6jTLHTrPPdfDSAwFGEN2Baiiy6cR1AMjd8E4UC2VWvDSnqOGv6EARukFyctWLEgreYK1wDSLRId5ONCrIn0fg8szDxGqayaGm0Bmra_jjTIcbRtop-qliFhWeI60LRLgOccUqdWU3hGhGjkPvRSgWqGJMx051LpQiwP3nvgo9ySllto4luE1IgU96jZpzUaTZga4RWRMN-13DqRXVup6iblS-kcPhAd-uKM3CAcPT7MjOJZlidSB6rRWQcAOxHANkrhKvxj5j4CK1GWxp11yoCnlVEpXSjWsVBor4moUbTZqt0xlnzINuweIMn8uMHRS-lYbEGYTwWNRdy0IsXvvo6XgymfI_QTr9mk4vcnyvjZ6Od-t3QAZu-UvTJmDNKOsebk5ShncfpFVjyZjHml475LBN72Pg3XkABOjmCIri7dtx)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**
---
| | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=831caad836c3409c9dc081a5eb097c7f&_e=ge4m_r1Jc7eRIh3SUR2wDHyT7XQFUDw0LFEzyzSQQft2B6G2-8c4lJcfsPyOe2U5NjweMKUYWeVVitviBpC5-2j72gXE3lcEQ2APnXGoI3is0bKRppSaiWcFwRQjnKmjnDKu7LDBhqjrJgYLlrlSCwDcDojhMB5nH_pTOFkPtKP5FQFIDSMmmkEsU0DXmOXxuOjjslgI093nZVtW21v6jTLHTrPPdfDSAwFGEN2Baiiy6cR1AMjd8E4UC2VWvDSnqOGv6EARukFyctWLEgreYK1wDSLRId5ONCrIn0fg8szDxGqayaGm0Bmra_jjTIcbRtop-qliFhWeI60LRLgOccUqdWU3hGhGjkPvRSgWqGJMx051LpQiwP3nvgo9ySllto4luE1IgU96jZpzUaTZga4RWRMN-13DqRXVup6iblS-kcPhAd-uKM3CAcPT7MjOJZlidSB6rRWQcAOxHANkrhKvxj5j4CK1GWxp11yoCnn8WplgFZeB42FX3vnEukZgSB5tKuZa2hNzLD9tgpL4QJGkwEwe9vlBUgIT4np-I7y0uYKwqNqyin_I4lVUg0fz1A8jPN6u77SyjYphNfUL5it08FPh7ZKQhK31lB2ggN7nTnarkfhwGEu-cOyyroPZ)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. | | | | | | Friend, Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future. Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>" Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days. "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?" | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, "I need your help – starting right now. " Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future. disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands
body:
Join me at the caucus on February 8. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f2dde6d0a9ac/re-hey-9344113?e=d30db4cde8)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Virgin Islanders:

Many of you know me. Many of us are also related as the Vialets have been Virgin Islanders for over 200 years. To put it into perspective, in my lifetime I can remember hearing the Danish language spoken on our islands.

What many of you don’t know is that I’m a Republican. My father was a Republican. My uncle David Vialet founded the V.I. Republican Party in 1948. I had the honor and privilege of advising Melvin H. Evans, a Republican and the first elected governor of the Virgin Islands.

**One party rule has failed the Virgin Islands.**

Our islands deserve better than the failed ideas and programs that the ruling party recycles year after year. It’s time to say enough is enough.

All of us deserve more jobs, bigger pay checks, safe drinking water, reliable and affordable electricity, roads without potholes, and, most importantly, good schools for our children and grandchildren.

I graduated Charlotte Amalie High School in 1963 and later attended Howard University, earning B.A. and J.D. degrees. I remember a different Virgin Islands — a Virgin Islands where every person had an equal opportunity for a better, brighter future.

**I’m asking you to send a message on Thursday, February 8 by voting in the[Republican presidential caucus](https://protonmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e6c445a9ccf2aeca06760698&id=a2db886716&e=d30db4cde8). This is our one and only chance to vote for president in 2024.**

The Democratic Party today is not the Democratic Party of the past. The party has left us. It’s a different animal altogether. Meanwhile, the Republican Party has returned to its roots as the party of the common man.

It doesn’t matter whether you support Donald Trump, Nikki Haley, or someone else, a vote in the Republican presidential caucus is a shot across the bow at the ruling party — a party that has nobody to blame but itself.

Your vote is your voice. Please use it on February 8.

_FRED VIALET JR. ESQ.
_

Join us this Saturday

**FELLOW PATRIOTS:**
As an advocate for parental rights, I understand the importance of being equipped with knowledge and tools to safeguard our families. That's why I'm inviting you to our inaugural **Texas Parental Rights Coalition** meeting this **Saturday**.
**_DETAILS_**
**Date:** Saturday, February 3
**Time:** 1 PM - 3 PM
**Location:** GPI Defense, 2455 FM 2920 Ste. A, Spring, TX 77388
**Special Guest:** Gabrielle Clark from ARC (Affirming Reality Connected)
Gabrielle Clark, a _fierce_ _advocate_ for educational integrity, will share her inspiring journey and practical advice on combating school indoctrination. Her experience in lawfare and coaching will empower you to assert and defend your rights against the encroachment of harmful ideologies.
This is more than just a meeting—it's the beginning of a movement. Together, we can ensure that your voices as parents are heard loud and clear and that your children's education remains true to your values.
Please **_RSVP_** at [https://jamesonellis.com/tprc](https://jamesonellis.lt.acemlna.com/Prod/link-tracker?redirectUrl=aHR0cHMlM0ElMkYlMkZqYW1lc29uZWxsaXMuY29tJTJGdHByYw==&sig=AoDrPBJV6QPNMfaHQQc2r8Qh4WPgFTgzfQRc7qXz1tjN&iat=1706568909&a=%7C%7C611311006%7C%7C&account=jamesonellis%2Eactivehosted%2Ecom&email=nq%2FnML%2FeGH6sSWY4%2FI2OAL9nuM24w2O%2Boqgi%2BY7iOT9QTzMl%3AqQuNP%2Bzq4TQ2jxFcwYuhY1g9YtMjBGaE&s=cabcbe31a720242486b887158a77876f&i=231A268A1A2072) to confirm attendance. Friend,
Have you met my friend Maureen Maloney?
Maureen Maloney, like me and KathyJo, serves on the Republican State Committee. Maureen is up for re-election, and represents the towns of Bellingham, Dover, Franklin, Medfield, Milford, Millis, Needham, Norfolk, Plainville, Sherborn, and Wrentham. If you or any of your friends are in her district, please cast your vote for her on March 5th.

If you've never met Maureen, here's a little more info on her.
Maureen is a Nurse Practitioner, married, and has lived in Milford for 25 years where she raised her 2 sons. Michael is her oldest and is an airline pilot.
Matthew, her youngest son, was tragically killed at 23 years old by an illegal alien. As a result of losing her son, she became an activist against illegal immigration.
She is a founding member and Vice President of Advocates for Victims of Illegal Alien Crime (AVIAC). She is the State Committeewoman seeking re-election in the Norfolk, Worcester, and Middlesex District. She was also the Chair of Fair and Secure Massachusetts, the committee responsible for getting Question 4, No Driver's License for illegal aliens, on the ballot last year.
She is the Treasurer for the Milford Republican Town Committee and was a delegate at the Republican State Convention in 2018 and 2022, as well as a delegate to the Republican National Convention in 2019.
She has volunteered on numerous Republican Candidate campaigns, including mine, and supported the back the blue police yard sign campaign.
If you are willing to support me and Maureen's races for the State Committee, so we can continue to fight for our candidates, you can do so at the link below. subject: Del. Sewell's Week 3 Session Newsletter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Briana Sewell
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/New%20Sewell%20Delegate%20Logo%20.png]
Session Week 3 Newsletter
Hello neighbors,
And just like that, the third week of the General Assembly session has come to an end! Now that we’re almost a month into session, I wanted to send a few updates and information on what’s going on in the House of Delegates.
This Week's Constituent Engagement and More
This week I had the opportunity to meet with some truly inspiring organizations and individuals. Thank you so much for taking the time to stop by! Your voice is critical, your feedback is important, and my staff and I appreciate you remaining active and engaged.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/IMG_0089.jpg]
Many thanks to Prince William Chamber of Commerce [https://pwchamber.org/] members Ross Snare and Bob Sweeney, who stopped by my office this week to discuss ways to support business and advance economic opportunity across Prince William County.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/IMG_0095.jpg]
It was so good to welcome members of the Prince William County School Board [https://www.pwcs.edu/leadership/school_board/index] (Richard Jessie, Lisa Zargarpur, and Loree Williams) to my office in Richmond to discuss improving student outcomes, supporting public education, and keeping our kids on the path to success.
I also met with members of the Virginia Economic Development Partnership [https://www.vedp.org/] to discuss bringing more business to the Commonwealth, spurring economic growth, and building a climate that incentivizes business investment.
Janet Settle from the Heart of Appalachia Tourism Authority [https://heartofappalachia.com/about-us/] stopped by my office. It was a pleasure to hear about the ongoing work of the Authority to increase tourism and statewide engagement with historic coalfield counties.
Similarly, it was a pleasure to meet with Alexandria City Councilman John Taylor Chapman to discuss regional opportunities from Prince William County through the rest of Virginia. Thanks so much for taking the time to visit and represent the Alexandria City Council [https://www.alexandriava.gov/Council] !
I was honored to participate in the CASA [https://wearecasa.org/program/community-organizing/] Community Impact Day and speak with these community organizers and members who came all the way down to Richmond to advocate for themselves and their communities.
As the Chair of the House Higher Education Subcommittee, it was great to meet with Virginia Tech President Tim Sands [https://www.president.vt.edu/] to discuss the many issues facing higher education and what we can do at the state level to best serve our students.
My staff also took part in the weekly NOVA Leaders meeting, hosted by Senator Mark Warner’s Office. This virtual meeting brings together leaders and their staff from across Northern Virginia to discuss issues facing our communities, learn about Senator Warner’s ongoing efforts in Congress, and discuss critical concerns like healthcare, transportation, education, and more.
I had the opportunity to meet with representatives from the Northern Virginia Electric Cooperative [https://www.novec.com/] (NOVEC) to discuss energy-related issues facing our communities.
My Bills and Subcommittees
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/IMG_0137_2.jpg]
In my very first newsletter this session, I outlined my legislative agenda, which focused primarily on helping all kids thrive, protecting our veterans, and supporting working families. I’m happy to report that several of these bills are on the move, and I continue to use my voice to address the issues that matter most to you. Below is the status of my bills that were heard this last week.
Naloxone in Schools: HB732 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB732] , passed unanimously out of the K-12 subcommittee [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sub+H09001] (8-Y 0-N) and the education committee [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+vot+H09V0033+HB0732] (21-Y 0-N) and referred to appropriations. This bill requires all K-12 schools to stock and store at least two doses of Naloxone, a life-saving drug which can reverse opioid overdoses in progress. The bill also requires that schools train at least one employee in each building to administer the dose, and will ensure legal immunity for any school employee who administers a dose in good-faith to save a life.
Equal Armed Services Benefits: HB738 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB738] , passed unanimously out of the public safety subcommittee [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sub+H15002] (6-Y 0-N), and was heard in the public safety full committee on Friday! This bill will extend the same benefits to members of the U.S. Space Force that are already provided to members of every other branch of U.S. armed forces.
Veterans' Services Protection Act: HB736 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB736] , passed unanimously out of the labor and commerce subcommittee #2 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sub+H14002] (8-Y 0-N) and will likely be heard in the labor and commerce full committee next week. This bill protects veterans from claim sharks who take advantage of veterans with false benefits guarantees and predatory contracts.
Paid Family and Medical Leave: HB737 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB737] , also passed out of the labor and commerce subcommittee #2 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sub+H14002] (5-Y 3-N) and will likely be heard in the labor and commerce full committee next week. This bill will establish Virginia’s first statewide paid family and medical leave insurance program.
Subcommittees
As I mentioned in last week’s email, I chair three House Subcommittees:
The House Education Subcommittee on Higher Education [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sub+H09002]
The House Transportation Subcommittee on the Department of Motor Vehicles [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sub+H19001]
The House Counties, Cities and Towns Subcommittee #2 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sub+H07002]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/Screenshot%202024-01-26%20at%208.39.58%20AM.png]
Chairing the Higher Education Subcommittee
This week, all three of these subcommittees met to consider 31 different bills. While that may seem like a lot, this is the important work we were elected to undertake, and it's vital that we review each piece of legislation thoroughly, discuss how it may impact residents of our districts and the Commonwealth as a whole, consider arguments both for and against, and make sure that all voices are heard before casting our votes. Bills we heard this last week and their status are listed below:
Higher Education Subcommittee
HB48 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB48] : passed the bill

HB207 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB207] : voted to incorporate with another bill ( HB827 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB827] )
HB366 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB366] : Amended the bill, passed it, and referred it to the Appropriations Committee [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+com+H2]
HB509 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB509] : passed the bill with a substitute
HB700 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB700] : passed the bill, and referred it to the Appropriations Committee [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+com+H2]
HB827 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB827] : passed the bill, and referred it to the Appropriations Committee [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+com+H2]
HB832 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB832] : passed the bill

Counties, Cities and Towns Subcommittee #2

HB755 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB755] : passed the bill
HB878 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB878] : passed the bill

HB1501 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+HB1501] : passed by for later discussion
This Week’s Mailbag & How to Contact our Office
As with prior weeks, we continue to receive emails covering a wide variety of issues. This week, a majority of the emails from you addressed health care, child care, gun violence prevention, and access to reproductive care. I sincerely appreciate all of your emails, as well as your phone calls and visits. Your ideas help guide my decision making and help keep our office informed about what Prince William County residents are experiencing. Thank you for reaching out!
You can contact my office several ways: email me at DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov [DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov] , call my office at 703-261-4787, or visit my Richmond office in person at 201 North 9 Street, Suite 905, Richmond, VA 23219. However you choose to reach out, I look forward to hearing from you and appreciate your continued engagement. I look forward to touching base next week with more updates.
