This bill will establish Virginia’s first statewide paid family and medical leave insurance program. Subcommittees As I mentioned in last week’s email, I chair three House Subcommittees: The House Education Subcommittee on Higher Education [] The House Transportation Subcommittee on the Department of Motor Vehicles [] The House Counties, Cities and Towns Subcommittee #2 [] [] Chairing the Higher Education Subcommittee This week, all three of these subcommittees met to consider 31 different bills. While that may seem like a lot, this is the important work we were elected to undertake, and it's vital that we review each piece of legislation thoroughly, discuss how it may impact residents of our districts and the Commonwealth as a whole, consider arguments both for and against, and make sure that all voices are heard before casting our votes. Bills we heard this last week and their status are listed below: Higher Education Subcommittee HB48 [] : passed the bill HB163 [] : passed the bill with a substitute HB207 [] : voted to incorporate with another bill ( HB827 [] ) HB366 [] : Amended the bill, passed it, and referred it to the Appropriations Committee [] HB509 [] : passed the bill with a substitute HB700 [] : passed the bill, and referred it to the Appropriations Committee [] HB827 [] : passed the bill, and referred it to the Appropriations Committee [] HB832 [] : passed the bill DMV Subcommittee HB425 [] : passed the bill HB840 [] : passed the bill HB844 [] : passed the bill with amendments HB845 [] : passed the bill HB95 [] : removed from the docket and will not move forward HB296 [] : removed from the docket and will not move forward HB548 [] : removed from the docket and will not move forward Counties, Cities and Towns Subcommittee #2 HB467 [] : passed the bill HB655 [] : passed by for later discussion HB683 [] : did not pass the bill HB721 [] : passed the bill, and referred it to the Courts of Justice Committee [] HB755 [] : passed the bill HB878 [] : passed the bill HB900 [] : passed by for later discussion HB947 [] : passed the bill HB952 [] : continued the bill to 2025 HB953 [] : passed the bill HB1070 [] : passed by for later discussion HB1119 [] : removed from the docket and will not move forward HB1122 [] : passed by for later discussion HB1211 [] : passed the bill HB1415 [] : passed by for later discussion HB1501 [] : passed by for later discussion This Week’s Mailbag & How to Contact our Office As with prior weeks, we continue to receive emails covering a wide variety of issues. This week, a majority of the emails from you addressed health care, child care, gun violence prevention, and access to reproductive care. I sincerely appreciate all of your emails, as well as your phone calls and visits. Your ideas help guide my decision making and help keep our office informed about what Prince William County residents are experiencing. Thank you for reaching out! You can contact my office several ways: email me at DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov [DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov] , call my office at 703-261-4787, or visit my Richmond office in person at 201 North 9 Street, Suite 905, Richmond, VA 23219. However you choose to reach out, I look forward to hearing from you and appreciate your continued engagement. I look forward to touching base next week with more updates. Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility. As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act. Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild. | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. | | | | | | Friend, Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future. Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>" Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days. "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?" | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, "I need your help – starting right now. " Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. Peter,
I was recently visiting with my 95-year old father (his name is Ed, and he lives in sunny Boca Raton, so he is known as BocaEddy) and he reminded me about a photo that — well I just _had_ to share it with you.
Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/77970609/452022102/443154033?amount=3&refcode=UTS_FR_90DO_240129_2_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5NDc2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQwNDE1NzNkLWM5YmUtZWUxMS1iNjYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=dk9nH-xIb1XhqhrSBvfi2dPtjEVl46EYOvrZGPORa9g=)

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.
We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.
This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.)
While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.
**In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.**
These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.
And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours.
That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.

name: Katie Porter
subject: re: Young lady, Wells Fargo doesn’t make mistakes
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=37091%2E3422442%2EgDBIgQ)
_Young lady, Wells Fargo does not make mistakes._
Those were the words I heard in late 2007 after presenting my research showing 70% of lenders were trying to collect more money than homeowners believed they owed.
Back up for a second: In 2007 I was a law professor researching whether banks were taking advantage of homeowners by claiming Americans owed more than they really did. In a sample of 1,700 cases, I found banks were asking people to pay $6 million more than they expected. **Banks repeatedly didn’t have the documentation to back up their claims, and nobody in the system was willing or able to stop them.** For so many families that meant losing their home entirely.
It was a Wells Fargo lawyer who stood up after I presented my findings at a conference and lectured me on how the vast teams at Wells Fargo could afford to follow the law, and plenty of other Big Bank lawyers chimed in. The conventional wisdom was that banks were always right, and nobody needed to question it.
**If banks don’t make mistakes, the next logical conclusion was that this was in fact a deliberate strategy to break the rules and cheat borrowers.**
Because of this research, a few months later I was asked to testify before the Senate Subcommittee on Administrative Oversight and the Courts. Senator Chuck Schumer came prepared with a poster board, and pointed out how Wall Street boasted their strategy of foreclosure and late fees helped them become even more profitable. I left that hearing thinking punishment was coming for those lawbreaking banks, but for the most part they continued to collect every penny without following every rule.
As a professor, I could study and point out problems. But I wanted to do more to actually change our system. I’m running for the U.S. Senate to fight for the people who have been taken advantage of by big corporations and are struggling to get ahead.
**That’s the work I’ve always done, and with your support I can head _back_ to the Senate—this time with the power to hold Wall Street to account. ****[I'd be so appreciative of anything you can chip in before 1/31 to help us meet our January fundraising goal and power our campaign.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240129-1?refcode=em20240129-37091&refcode2=37091_3422442_gDBIgQ&akid=37091%2E3422442%2EgDBIgQ)**

Katie Porter

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=em20240129-37091&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=37091_3422442_gDBIgQ&akid=37091%2E3422442%2EgDBIgQ)**

[](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDYsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYXNlbmF0ZWRlbW9jcmF0cy5vcmcvczQ2LyIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDAxMjkuODkzMDEzOTEifQ.pzftlQ2AryrOr7zNzG1JLAVxmesR4v_v9D_SEC34WkM/s/2950175210/br/236164341150-l)

Neighbors, thank you for your outreach to me expressing concern about SB 52, the bill to overturn your vote on transit & traffic safety. **SB 52 will be voted on in the Senate a final time TODAY at 1:30PM**. There's still time to win this -- contact lawmakers, [sign my open letter](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDcsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYXNlbmF0ZWRlbW9jcmF0cy5vcmcvczQ2LyIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDAxMjkuODkzMDEzOTEifQ.NIY_2eMBrzVDp_RcomLl5sS6OR--AACjDWsfEEODfSg/s/2950175210/br/236164341150-l) and _show up to say that transit is essential_!
| |
* * *
---
## SB 52 Threatens Transit for All, Not Just Indy
---
SB 52 presents a statewide ban on dedicated bus lanes as a 1-year "moratorium" that would almost certainly end Indy's Blue Line project as we know it. The bill now also combines this with a retroactive ban on No Turn on Red signs in Indianapolis. These regressive attacks on transit and road safety single out Indy for scrutiny -- this is not principled public policy. It's never been about dedicated bus lanes. It's about whether or not we allow the local governments of cities and towns to govern themselves.
* * *
---
## My DNA Privacy Bill Passed Committee,
On Second Reading Today
[](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDgsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lmluc3RhZ3JhbS5jb20vc2VuYXRvcmh1bmxleS8iLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwMTI5Ljg5MzAxMzkxIn0.-vT_zo1539zcUL80rrJSmjtYNa2qXswXZdr-d0cybFA/s/2950175210/br/236164341150-l) Indiana doesn't have protections around DNA & genetic data privacy. My bill SB 284 will change that by holding DNA data service providers accountable for protecting your information. I am a proud co-author of this bipartisan legislation that received unanimous support from the Commerce & Technology Committee last week and will receive its first vote on the Senate Floor this afternoon.

SB 52 will be voted on in the Senate a final time TODAY at 1:30PM. There's still time to win this -- contact lawmakers, and show up to say that transit is essential! | | SB 52 Threatens Transit for All, Not Just Indy SB 52 presents a statewide ban on dedicated bus lanes as a 1-year "moratorium" that would almost certainly end Indy's Blue Line project as we know it. The bill now also combines this with a retroactive ban on No Turn on Red signs in Indianapolis. These regressive attacks on transit and road safety single out Indy for scrutiny -- this is not principled public policy. It's never been about dedicated bus lanes. It's about whether or not we allow the local governments of cities and towns to govern themselves. My DNA Privacy Bill Passed Committee, On Second Reading Today Indiana doesn't have protections around DNA & genetic data privacy. My bill SB 284 will change that by holding DNA data service providers accountable for protecting your information. I am a proud co-author of this bipartisan legislation that received unanimous support from the Commerce & Technology Committee last week and will receive its first vote on the Senate Floor this afternoon. STORIES SHAPING OUR STATE I continue to be concerned about the march towards automatic retention for 3rd Graders who are not meeting literacy standards. There are many good aspects to the majority's bill, but I voted against it in committee because amendments from myself and others to make sure we are carefully considering family impacts & approaching the problem holistically were rejected. I hope all stakeholders will find the right path forward here for our struggling schoolkids as the bill moves to the floor today, I sat down the first week of Session with Jon Schwantes to talk through my legislative agenda. You can view our full conversation here! Indiana has a 694:1 student-to-counselor ratio, one of the worst in the nation. Peter,

lobby group AIPAC was planning on spending an unprecedented $100 million

It turns out they’ve already spent more than $1 million on Facebook and

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240129.WUUnZc&refcode=em20240129-33060&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=33060%2E1203867%2ELQtcHT ]Table of Top Political Ad Spenders on Facebook and Instagram January

Source: FWIW

mega-donors, and they’ve used it to support more than 100 Republican
insurrectionists who sought to overturn the 2020 presidential election.

We can’t let AIPAC succeed in pushing any of our Squad members out of
Congress this year. Justice Democrats is fighting back and doing
everything in our power to re-elect our progressive incumbents, but unlike
AIPAC, we depend on grassroots contributions from people like you.

progressive champions in Congress this election cycle, so we can’t waste a

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in

using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=33060%2E1203867%2ELQtcHT ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

The Swamp wants me EXPELLED from the Senate - Don't let them win - FIGHT BACK & STAND WITH ME | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/billeigel/conservatives-under-siege-in-missouri?e=c00a6982d2)

I was elected to represent the people, not special interests.
| | **🚨****Senate "Leadership" Threatens to Expel Me****🚨**
* * *
Last week, Missouri Senate "Leadership" took unprecedented action against me and other Freedom Caucus members.

**Tuesday** \- They stripped our chairmanships, our parking spots, and $10,000 out of each of our staff office budgets.

**Wednesday** \- We heard they might confiscate our office furniture.

**Thursday** \- They threatened to [__**EXPEL**__](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=cea29580bb&e=c00a6982d2) me from the Senate.

"Leadership" called us swamp creatures that take orders from D.C.

Do I strike you as someone that's taking orders from anybody but my constituents?

My constituents elected me to represent them, and that is what I'll continue to do.

**Help me _FIGHT BACK_ against The Swamp's efforts to kick me out of the Senate!**
---

| | **Missouri Right to Life's statement standing with the Freedom Caucus**
* * *
On January 18th, Senators Denny Hoskins, Andrew Koenig, Rick Brattin, and __**Bill Eigel**__ bravely stood on the Senate floor and unapologetically advocated for the passage of legislation on Initiative Petition reform.

But instead of facilitating this vital pro-life legislation, which is also part of the Republican Party platform, Senate President Pro Tem Caleb Rowden and Senate Majority Floor Leader Cindy O'Laughlin called these four senators "swamp creatures," stripped them of committee positions and even took away their parking spots.

For Senate leaders Rowden and O'Laughlin to strip four true conservative Senior Senators from their ability to serve their districts of 174,000 people as chairman of committees is petty, vindictive, and is the epitome of an abuse of power

Senators Rowden and O'Laughlin are continuing a trend over the past five years of Senate leadership failing to create unity in the Senate. They have progressively stood against all conservative legislation that is set forth in the Republican Party platform while they have stalled out pro-life legislation, such as defunding Planned Parenthood and Initiative Petition reform. They have succumbed to lobbyists big money that say, "having no bill is better than a bill with pro-life language."
---
| | **STOP THE INVASION**
* * *
We need to send as many Missouri National Guardsmen as we can to STOP the invasion at the Southern Border.

Joe Biden has caused the invasion at our southern border and refused to stop it. That’s why conservative governors are having to take matters into their own hands. As governor, I’ll do everything in my power to help Texas secure the border — _**every state is a border state**_ and we’re feeling the impacts of it every day here in Missouri.

My message to those here illegally: enjoy it while it lasts, because the moment my hand comes off the Bible at the inauguration, we’re taking action to deport illegals out-of-here and restore law and order in Missouri.

| | | **🔥ELIMINATE PERSONAL PROPERTY TAX🔥**
* * *
As governor, I promise to ELIMINATE personal property tax in its ENTIRETY!

You should not have to pay "rent" to the government every year for the "crime" of just owning a vehicle. Government taxes us when we buy, sell, or just own a vehicle. THIS IS OUTRAGEOUS!

My opponents, Jay Ashcroft and Mike Kehoe, have both publicly said they will not support my plan to cut personal property tax in Missouri.

Check out my presentation of SB 733 below ⬇️⬇️⬇️

Setting the record straight

body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=879acc729fbd4761a4cd5dfbbb355127&_e=r5XmYQd9rnxGTGUnJRB6QB_kU_kztI8YRTWDGf9eXvQsS8PQwWqm3MRWoUuOpWArCCKoy7n16Ner-K14ZymYGAtCSkd60fHD_HHhwMFMpPP_w1ziZJGDM1cWzIgG7FNuSoaViV6HWSoEFI7u9BAGACkoNOVutpmt8MzBlCp5YYxWmOZcAG__eublJxPVWCr8leTPyFvSDNeAcOq9t1rpdeO0McuEQzOahG5WMegWcI28Nb5ftstP1_1QpiSbGafXDtXzUUMlbFP1YAQSaMewnvdPgoGC1D7NUSLMXBNXnmHsoV2TyG0lPD9Q6zc6S0c6jIfnDNmNgXkvCZF2fAOotlJLrAPaTv7GSQTm7yM9tE54opbmB9jCITCdK3HzY9mOPTjgdRT4kbgeZip5eYG4AjXPKhlSknqJSKT2xhA9kRE%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. clean_body: A proud Arizonan and lifelong Democrat, Conor O'Callaghan is running to represent Arizona's 1st Congressional District and unseat MAGA Republican David Schweikert. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | | = Peter: My family is a product of the American Dream. In 1983, my family immigrated from Ireland to America. When I was four, we moved to Scottsdale, Arizona, where my siblings and I grew up. Meanwhile, on the other side of the world, my future wife and her family fled Tehran during the Iranian Revolution in 1979. Our families both sought and achieved the American Dream. But in 2024 MAGA Republicans like our current Congressman David Schweikert are doing everything they can to undermine the spirit of the American Dream. Just a few weeks ago, Trump claimed that immigrants are " poisoning the blood of our country." Then House Speaker Mike Johnson backed him up. I'm running for Congress to reclaim the American Dream for future generations. I want to use my experience in finance to make our economy work again. I want to ensure that women, LGBTQ+ folks, and communities of color have rights and protections. And I want to protect our sacred democracy — you know, the one Republicans tried to overthrow on January 6th? = If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now. | = | = | = | = | = | = I truly believe we can build an Arizona where all families thrive, where small businesses flourish, and all are welcome. It starts here. Sincerely, Conor O'Callaghan | | | ---|---|--- = As a proud Arizonan and lifelong Democrat, Conor O'Callaghan is wholeheartedly committed to enshrining Roe v. Wade into law, safeguarding our communities against gun violence, addressing the urgent challenges posed by climate change and our water crisis, and ensuring that everyone contributes their equitable share in taxes. It's time for a new, forward-thinking direction.** | = = Paid for by Conor for AZ Conor for AZ P.O. Friend, the last few months since launching this campaign have been nothing short of life-changing.

I'm so inspired by the outpouring of support from supporters like you and voters all across Florida. After hearing your stories and watching so many of you put your trust in my campaign, I'm more determined than ever before to win this race and flip Florida blue. But now, it's time to kick this campaign into high gear — and I need your help to do it.
**I'm just a few days away from my very first end-of-month deadline of 2024, and the stakes are higher than ever. That's why I've set an ambitious $400,000 goal.**
It's hard to overstate just how big of a deal this deadline is. This is our chance to set the tone for 2024 and show Rick Scott that we mean business. It's also our first big opportunity to gather the resources that we're going to need to compete with Scott's massive fortune.
**If we miss this goal, we'd be signaling to Rick Scott, Mitch McConnell, and the entire country that our campaign is vulnerable. The GOP won't hesitate to blanket the airwaves with even more attacks to destroy our campaign before we have a chance to fight back. **Because if we fall short here, we won't be able to run the ads that we need to run, reach the key voters that we need to reach, or build the kind of ground game that will win us this election.
**The polling data shows just how close this race is, friend. We can't waste this incredible momentum now.[But if we want to hit this goal, I need everyone who cares about saving our Senate majority to step up right now. After hearing your stories and watching so many of you put your trust in my campaign, I'm more determined than ever before to win this race and flip Florida blue. But now, it's time to kick this campaign into high gear — and I need your help to do it. I'm just a few days away from my very first end-of-month deadline of 2024, and the stakes are higher than ever. That's why I've set an ambitious $400,000 goal. It's hard to overstate just how big of a deal this deadline is. This is our chance to set the tone for 2024 and show Rick Scott that we mean business. It's also our first big opportunity to gather the resources that we're going to need to compete with Scott's massive fortune. If we miss this goal, we'd be signaling to Rick Scott, Mitch McConnell, and the entire country that our campaign is vulnerable. The GOP won't hesitate to blanket the airwaves with even more attacks to destroy our campaign before we have a chance to fight back. Because if we fall short here, we won't be able to run the ads that we need to run, reach the key voters that we need to reach, or build the kind of ground game that will win us this election. The polling data shows just how close this race is, friend. We can't waste this incredible momentum now.= If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you so much, Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

body:
My endorsement of Donald Trump. Plus, two powerful Marches for Life and big events you don't want to miss!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

The campaign trail has been buzzing with energy, and I'm excited to share the highlights of another phenomenal week! From supporting crucial bills and issues to participating in two powerful March for Life events and engaging with Hoosiers statewide to convey my vision for Indiana—our collective efforts continue to make an impact!

Read on for the highlights!

** IN THE NEWS: Crouch Endorses Donald Trump for President (https://www.mywabashvalley.com/news/indianas-lt-governor-endorses-former-president-trump/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

President Donald J. Trump’s victory in New Hampshire this evening is a testament to his popularity and resilience. We need a president who grows the economy—not our list of enemies.

We need a return to economic growth, a strong foreign policy, and a chief executive who cares about our borders. All Republicans need to unite behind the next president of the United States—Donald Trump.
https://www.mywabashvalley.com/news/indianas-lt-governor-endorses-former-president-trump/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
READ THE ARTICLE (https://www.mywabashvalley.com/news/indianas-lt-governor-endorses-former-president-trump/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** IN THE NEWS: Crouch supports limiting governor's emergency powers (https://www.nwitimes.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/governor-legislature-emergency-powers-limit/article_a98e2896-bafe-11ee-bd70-373f2e4e322c.html?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

Senate Bill 234, limiting executive powers in an emergency, has my full support. As governor, I will work with legislators to ensure the voices of their constituents are heard in any prolonged emergency situation in Indiana. Hoosiers have a right to know if their rights are being curtailed unnecessarily.
https://www.nwitimes.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/governor-legislature-emergency-powers-limit/article_a98e2896-bafe-11ee-bd70-373f2e4e322c.html?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
READ THE ARTICLE (https://www.nwitimes.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/governor-legislature-emergency-powers-limit/article_a98e2896-bafe-11ee-bd70-373f2e4e322c.html?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** STATEMENT: Backing Texas Gov. Greg Abbott
------------------------------------------------------------

The most recent refusal of Biden to enforce immigration laws at the Texas border is the latest example that our federal government has abandoned the states and abandoned America's security. I agree with Greg Abbott that this is an invasion.

It is clear evidence that Governors must take action.

** Defining Moments for Life in Indiana!
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/reel/1055010348901326?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Last week, I participated in two impactful March For Life rallies across our state.

Thousands of courageous individuals gathered on Sanctity of Human Life Day for the Indianapolis March for Life (https://www.facebook.com/reel/1055010348901326?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , and on Saturday, thousands more joined the March for Life in Fort Wayne.

https://www.facebook.com/reel/1055010348901326?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Standing among these dedicated individuals was a profound honor as we collectively championed the cause of life.

Under my leadership, Indiana has become one of the most pro-life states in the country and, as your Governor, I️ will ensure it remains so.
https://www.facebook.com/reel/1055010348901326?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

https://www.facebook.com/reel/1055010348901326?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** 1st Safe Haven Surrender this Year
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I was a part of a news conference announcing the first baby surrendered to a Safe Haven Baby Box (https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in Indiana this year. My heartfelt thanks go to the courageous parent who made this profoundly difficult and selfless decision.

This surrender is a powerful victory for life, showcasing the effectiveness of the Safe Haven Baby Box program in saving innocent children's lives.

** First Principles Candidate Forum
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Grateful for the opportunity at the First Principles Candidate Forum to share my vision for Indiana, emphasizing (https://x.com/Suzanne_Crouch/status/1750682076850839850?s=20&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) parental choice (https://twitter.com/Suzanne_Crouch/status/1750682701735047379?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in education, an energy plan (https://twitter.com/Suzanne_Crouch/status/1750683498719896058?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) focused on affordability and sustainability, and my concrete tax reduction (https://twitter.com/Suzanne_Crouch/status/1750691279346774281?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) strategy, Axe The Tax (https://crouchforindiana.com/axe-the-tax/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

** Engaging with the Next Generation of Leaders
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I had the pleasure of participating in a Q&A session with Lakeland Christian Academy students alongside Congressman Rudy Yakym, Sen. Ryan Mishler, and Rep. Craig Snow.

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

It was inspiring to see these young minds eager to learn about our duties as politicians and to answer their thought-provoking questions.

The future of our state is in good hands with such bright and engaged students!
https://www.facebook.com/reel/1055010348901326?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

https://www.facebook.com/reel/1055010348901326?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** Celebrating Lincoln's Legacy in Rush County
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

It was an honor to attend and speak at the Rush County Lincoln Day Dinner. As a presidential history buff, the stories of Abraham Lincoln always captivate me.

Thank you to Rush County GOP Chair Janet Kile for organizing this dinner! I love how these gatherings bring our Republican family together and remind us of the importance of preserving our rich history.
https://www.facebook.com/reel/1055010348901326?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

https://www.facebook.com/reel/1055010348901326?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** ICYMI: Endorsements (https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
Suzanne Crouch is the only gubernatorial candidate who has been endorsed by more than 100 past and present elected officials in Indiana. A full list of those endorsements can be found here. (https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** Last but not least...
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=16ec38090b-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_01_26_07_18&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-16ec38090b-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

It has truly been an incredible week, thanks to you!

As we press forward on the road to the May Primary (with less than 100 days to go!), I'm thrilled by the progress we've achieved together.

Together, we will shape a brighter future for Indiana and enhance the lives of Hoosiers across our great state.

clean_body: My endorsement of Donald Trump. Plus, two powerful Marches for Life and big events you don't want to miss! Friends and fellow Hoosiers, The campaign trail has been buzzing with energy, and I'm excited to share the highlights of another phenomenal week! From supporting crucial bills and issues to participating in two powerful March for Life events and engaging with Hoosiers statewide to convey my vision for Indiana—our collective efforts continue to make an impact! Read on for the highlights! IN THE NEWS: Crouch Endorses Donald Trump for President () President Donald J. Trump’s victory in New Hampshire this evening is a testament to his popularity and resilience. We need a president who grows the economy—not our list of enemies. We need a return to economic growth, a strong foreign policy, and a chief executive who cares about our borders. All Republicans need to unite behind the next president of the United States—Donald Trump. READ THE ARTICLE () IN THE NEWS: Crouch supports limiting governor's emergency powers () Senate Bill 234, limiting executive powers in an emergency, has my full support. As governor, I will work with legislators to ensure the voices of their constituents are heard in any prolonged emergency situation in Indiana. Hoosiers have a right to know if their rights are being curtailed unnecessarily. READ THE ARTICLE () STATEMENT: Backing Texas Gov. Greg Abbott The most recent refusal of Biden to enforce immigration laws at the Texas border is the latest example that our federal government has abandoned the states and abandoned America's security. I agree with Greg Abbott that this is an invasion. It is clear evidence that Governors must take action. Defining Moments for Life in Indiana! Last week, I participated in two impactful March For Life rallies across our state. Thousands of courageous individuals gathered on Sanctity of Human Life Day for the Indianapolis March for Life () , and on Saturday, thousands more joined the March for Life in Fort Wayne. Standing among these dedicated individuals was a profound honor as we collectively championed the cause of life. Under my leadership, Indiana has become one of the most pro-life states in the country and, as your Governor, I️ will ensure it remains so. 1st Safe Haven Surrender this Year I was a part of a news conference announcing the first baby surrendered to a Safe Haven Baby Box () in Indiana this year. My heartfelt thanks go to the courageous parent who made this profoundly difficult and selfless decision. This surrender is a powerful victory for life, showcasing the effectiveness of the Safe Haven Baby Box program in saving innocent children's lives. First Principles Candidate Forum Grateful for the opportunity at the First Principles Candidate Forum to share my vision for Indiana, emphasizing () parental choice () in education, an energy plan () focused on affordability and sustainability, and my concrete tax reduction () strategy, Axe The Tax () . Engaging with the Next Generation of Leaders I had the pleasure of participating in a Q&A session with Lakeland Christian Academy students alongside Congressman Rudy Yakym, Sen. Ryan Mishler, and Rep. Craig Snow. It was inspiring to see these young minds eager to learn about our duties as politicians and to answer their thought-provoking questions. The future of our state is in good hands with such bright and engaged students! Celebrating Lincoln's Legacy in Rush County It was an honor to attend and speak at the Rush County Lincoln Day Dinner. As a presidential history buff, the stories of Abraham Lincoln always captivate me. Thank you to Rush County GOP Chair Janet Kile for organizing this dinner! I love how these gatherings bring our Republican family together and remind us of the importance of preserving our rich history. ICYMI: Endorsements () Suzanne Crouch is the only gubernatorial candidate who has been endorsed by more than 100 past and present elected officials in Indiana. A full list of those endorsements can be found here. () Last but not least... It has truly been an incredible week, thanks to you! They are the ONLY firewall we have to stop Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer's radical agenda. And even then, our Majority in the House comes down to just a few seats. **That 's why this email is especially important.**

* The 2023 State Budget authored by Matt Dolan achieved universal school choice in Ohio.

* Dolan voted to ban critical race theory from classrooms in Ohio.

* Dolan expanded EdChoice eligibility, allowing more Ohio students to utilize the program.

* Dolan fought to secure $550 million for Ohio's schools to be used for mental health services, after-school opportunities for at-risk students and health clinics for underserved areas.

* Dolan voted to give our schools flexibility in continuing blended learning options. The bill states schools must teach students in-person for a majority of the year but allows flexibility when it is not possible.

* Dolan co-sponsored a bill to include a financial literacy course as part of the state's high school curriculum.

* Dolan was named the 2021 Legislator of the Year by the Public Children Services Association of Ohio (PCSAO) for his leadership and commitment to children and families involved in the children services system.

#
Friends,
Not even a week after what would have been the 51st anniversary of _Roe_ , Wisconsin Republicans continue their attempts to steal reproductive rights from Wisconsin women.
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jan24.Ibl7yb&refcode=em240129-1-nor-tt12&t=1&akid=5175%2E196590%2E04126F)
That’s right. Wisconsin Republicans are trying to ban abortions after 14 weeks of pregnancy.
This bill blatantly defies women’s bodily autonomy and freedom to make choices about their bodies, all under the claim of being “pro-life.”
These are the same “pro-life” Republicans who refuse to pass comprehensive gun safety legislation to prevent mass shootings and save innocent lives.
These Republicans aren't “pro-life,” they are pro-birth. And they will do everything they can to inflict their personal beliefs on Wisconsin women.
This issue is personal. Before me, my mother had a complicated pregnancy that could’ve taken her life. Back then, she had the right to choose and decided to end the pregnancy. If my mom hadn't made that decision, I am not sure she or I would be here today.
Choice matters, yet Republicans continue to try to steal bodily autonomy from women.
We cannot let them continue to abuse their power to limit the rights of Wisconsinites. It’s time to take back the legislative majority in Wisconsin and elect pro-choice Democrats up and down the ballot this November.

# Holding Fire by Bryce Andrews
Jesse James reached out to Fact and Fiction store owner Mara for his second book club recommendation.
“Holding Fire” by Bryce Andrews tells the story of a young man raised to do no harm.
From the book description: “The son of a pacifist and conscientious objector, he moved from Seattle to Montana to tend livestock and the land as a cowboy. For a decade, he was happy. Yet, when Andrews inherited his grandfather’s Smith & Wesson revolver, he felt the weight of the violence braided into his chosen life. Other white men who’d come before him had turned firearms like this one against wildlife, wilderness, and the Indigenous peoples who had lived in these landscapes for millennia. This was how the West was “won.” Now, the losses were all around him and a weapon was in his hand.”
From Bryce to the supporters of Jesse James Mullen: “Holding Fire is about an inherited revolver, the work of ranching, and the necessary work of forging a decent, less violent future from the compromised materials of our past.”
Bryce wished Jesse luck in his campaign for Secretary of State and expressed appreciation to the book club members for reading his memoir.
For our second bookstore, we’re visiting [Fact & Fiction](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=2c73b58eb3&e=805e709ff8) in Missoula. Fact & Fiction was once associated with the University of Montana but was recently purchased by long-time manager Mara.
If you’d like to read along with Jesse, reply or send him an email with the subject line: Book Club.
[To order Holding Fire, click here.](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=51dfa9c65e&e=805e709ff8)

For our second bookstore, we’re visiting in Missoula. Fact & Fiction was once associated with the University of Montana but was recently purchased by long-time manager Mara. If you’d like to read along with Jesse, reply or send him an email with the subject line: Book Club. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=999b1e79a2d047d3ad67dd39ca7c376c&_e=AEVSVHqN-NXFiRhF5_yncMq8iSJ3hpDscU8C7c_G3wZ9O45yTD9lBEcAZ1EW6f3jalHKzXUQQ3ZqY2PkQL_wJSvsPS5E1KHvu_QOj_7Md8B-R8Daci0mswA5G1l0D2rJu-wGQOjCiW9SxFxo-R4s6PYdiR1NsxYMz7SyLJ3B_wymngKkXrZA3u1ROg23Cpn6I2SinHRR4fRWyPKDgkog6Ypp5dBAznWhSolTPzmL0KdsTuyWWyJcX-fIzoQPdvE3f-XchooqE58O9-syXRAE9MjACADUrEDtI0QcmeRK23cU1qBq8281o_l38zaIQweAVcRaJxTFTRlsKvgilhgz_B72KbckPnAMZCThkofjA4K4iDpKOgYtVHTtWMDZELlBM4qAs6psawnmkpo6bXD4XUNE9SpLpU3BLRHBLsCxNQQ%3D)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest—with an Ivy League degree—said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. **That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course,["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=999b1e79a2d047d3ad67dd39ca7c376c&_e=AEVSVHqN-NXFiRhF5_yncMq8iSJ3hpDscU8C7c_G3wZ9O45yTD9lBEcAZ1EW6f3jalHKzXUQQ3ZqY2PkQL_wJSvsPS5E1KHvu_QOj_7Md8B-R8Daci0mswA5G1l0D2rJu-wGQOjCiW9SxFxo-R4s6PYdiR1NsxYMz7SyLJ3B_wymngKkXrZA3u1ROg23Cpn6I2SinHRR4fRWyPKDgkog6Ypp5dBAznWhSolTPzmL0KdsTuyWWyJcX-fIzoQPdvE3f-XchooqE58O9-syXRAE9OH2tY_DGJT_BZB08GotWulN1qfW-B7aaiNk7b1kCKZ2tN5T8XMmw0SYlW4NJjz6OpDV74j2d5qOB-jxy7HNjKsp_fXEqPXdziMsOryMNbe4n-0Dj1uTD3cA-LancjH8fMV-UpP2awAUYR8jTPNvrJI%3D)****on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

subject: let me explain, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mad4PA PAC
body:
**** Peter, you’ve been hearing from my team and me quite a bit lately. I hope you don’t mind me connecting with you today to explain why we are trying so hard to get in contact.

By now you are probably well aware of the ballot access process: A candidate collects signatures, submits them to the state, signatures are verified, and if the signature threshold is met, said candidate’s name will appear on the ballot.

_Here’s the part that we haven’t explained: why this process is so important..._

The act of collecting signatures – coordinating the on-the-ground efforts and connecting with voters willing to sign a petition paper – is a big test of grassroots momentum – _especially in such a pivotal election year._

**The Philadelphia suburbs are always on the radar of national Republican mega-donors, and with such a spotlight on us, we need to ensure we have the resources to fully power our ballot access program – the first big grassroots test of 2024. My team and I have determined that we need to raise another $7,000 to meet the moment.[Only if you are able, can I count on you to donate before our end-of-month budget deadline on Wednesday?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77983150/452048959/-1621122687?amount=25&refcode=01292024_MD_EOM_FR_1&refcode2=e9865f9a-d8be-ee11-b660-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTg2NWY5YS1kOGJlLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jC5JUGbw_SFaKX-URDUWXt_WUoWuXkABD81xFUAA9M0=)**

My concern isn’t collecting signatures – our team of supporters have proven themselves time and again. I know they are up to the challenge.

However, I am concerned that pundits, the media, potential opponents, and the NRCC need a clear-as-day visual of our energy and momentum in PA-04 – a must-win geography in a must-win swing state. That’s why we’re so focused on executing an effective, intentional, and robust signature collection program.

**But I need your help to make that happen, Peter.[Your help today is greatly appreciated](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77983151/452048962/-1621122687?amount=25&refcode=01292024_MD_EOM_FR_1&refcode2=e9865f9a-d8be-ee11-b660-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTg2NWY5YS1kOGJlLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jC5JUGbw_SFaKX-URDUWXt_WUoWuXkABD81xFUAA9M0=)** and will directly support our ballot access program.

Together, we will protect and defend the Philadelphia suburbs.

More soon,

Madeleine [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77983152/452048963/-1621122687?amount=25&refcode=01292024_MD_EOM_FR_1&refcode2=e9865f9a-d8be-ee11-b660-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTg2NWY5YS1kOGJlLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jC5JUGbw_SFaKX-URDUWXt_WUoWuXkABD81xFUAA9M0=)

---
Welcome to Teichert on the Trail, our weekly email highlighting the latest news and events from the campaign as retired Air Force Brigadier General John Teichert earns the hearts, minds, and votes of Marylanders in the race to be their next U.S. Senator.
**Teichert in the News**
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=2e5bb79117&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
On Thursday, January 25th, General John Teichert joined Sean Casey and Bruce Elliot on [WCBM ](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=05f40031a4&e=1b1fb1ad9f)to discuss his bid for U.S. Senate, the recent Law Enforcement for Teichert coalition, and his take on national security at the southern border. When asked about his plan to restore strength, capability, will, and resolve in America, Teichert responded, “Every one of those sheriff’s that I have been talking to can trace back real public safety problems and drug problems here in Maryland to a feckless policy on the southern border. We need to secure our border- that’s number one- and then after we do that, we can have comprehensive immigration reform. But right now, it’s a multi-faceted crisis: it’s a national security crisis, a public health crisis, public safety crisis, and a humanitarian crisis.”
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=e703dd43d9&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
John Teichert was proud to announce a whopping $304,000 in campaign fundraising, thanks to generous donations by supporters across the state who are ready for collaborative conservative leadership in Maryland, and know that General Teichert is the man for the job. Read the full article reported by [Hotline here. ](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=c7f28d3943&e=1b1fb1ad9f)

# Endorsement Alert!
This week, General Teichert was honored to receive an endorsement from Congressman Mark Green (TN-07), Chair of the House Committee on Homeland Security. Read his full statement [here!](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=a140236eea&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
|

**Thoughts by Teichert**
On Thursday, January 25th, General Teichert shared his respect and gratitude for our medical professional heroes who save lives every day. Watch his full video [here](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=e829b99bf7&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=fa41641234&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
On Friday, January 26th, General Teichert released “Burning Our Resources and Wasting Our Time”, a written piece in which he addresses the chronic dysfunction of Congress after yet another continuing resolution passed last week. General Teichert highlights the shortcomings of governmental dysfunction, and why his background and experience will be able to wrestle our great nation back to where it belongs. Read his full column [here. ](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=9800bc4e58&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
Thank you for joining John on trail as he looks to become the next U.S. Senator for the State of Maryland. Make sure to check out [www.teichertformaryland.com](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=44fd312e5a&e=1b1fb1ad9f) and see how you can donate, get involved, and join the mailing list!

Fellow American,
I am happy to announce that I was able to submit my first batch of signatures to get on the ballot against Susan Wild.
I am humbled by the hard work and dedication of so many volunteers, family, and friends who helped us be the first to file petitions to get on the ballot in the 7th Congressional District. Being able to file nearly 20% more than the required signatures in just one week is a sign of how strong our campaign and our grassroots team can be when working together. But we aren’t done yet.
I know there are still tons of circulators out there helping me gather even more signatures. Please continue the effort of collecting more petition signatures. We will be filing supplemental petitions, which are a very important part of the process and help us add to our initial filing.
Please return your petitions to the campaign by Friday, February 9th - either by mailing them to Mackenzie for Congress, P.O. Box 747, Emmaus PA 18049, or we will collect them from you by calling our campaign at (484) 347-8777.
Thank you again to everyone who is working so hard to help us.
All the Best,
Ryan Mackenzie
(Filed My Petitions for U.S. Congress This Morning)
|
---
**UPCOMING EVENT:**
State Representative Joe Emerick and Ryan Mackenzie for Congress petition signing event Wednesday, January 31st. From 5:00 P.M. to 7:30 P.M. at Mitzi’s Table: 3650 Nazareth Pike Bethlehem, PA 18020.
|
---
**AROUND THE DISTRICT:**
It was because of the countless supporters across our communities that we were able to hold seven successful petition signing parties all across PA-7. Here are a few pictures from the events. Hundreds of people and overflow crowds came out to support me, and I won’t let them down.

|
---
**WILD IS WILD:**
In case you didn’t see it, recent news reports exposed Susan Wild for being “dismayed” by having to represent many of the people of the 7th Congressional District. Her words are simply wrong, and I put out the following statement calling on her to step down because of them:
“Susan Wild’s comments reveal what many already know: unless you agree with her and her radical policies, she doesn’t care about you or representing you. Disagreement over issues is certainly acceptable, but her disrespect for those who do not agree with her is simply wrong. If Susan Wild is so ‘dismayed’ by the people she represents, she should step down and not run again.”

| | In this newsletter:
* Rural Americans United Program Showing Big Dividends
* Dayton Library Overcomes Siege, Brings Statewide Benefits
* MAGA's School Board Failures: Pushing Religious Schools
* Donald Trump's Divine Providence Confirmed
* Latino Community Fund and Progresso invite you to join them

---
| | |
---
| | Putting the Squeeze on MAGA: Reminding Central Washington Who We Are
---
| | In just under four months, Rural Americans United's groundbreaking pro-Democratic value messaging campaign in Central Washington has shown remarkable results.
* There's been a notable uptick in new and renewed interest in engaging with the Democratic party, signaling a tangible shift in political engagement across the region.

* Traditional media outlets are once again taking notice of Democratic stories, a welcome change after years of being overlooked.

* We've assembled an Advisory Board that reflects the region's rich demographics to ensure that our campaign continues to resonate with the diverse voices of Central Washington.

* We're coordinating a scientific poll to gauge the real impact of our programs, providing valuable insights into the effectiveness of our messaging and outreach efforts.

But to sustain this crucial work, we rely on your support. Your recurring monthly donations provide the financial stability we need to plan for the future of the program.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0aOrMcET_/c?w=H1Fg0UAlp5astC0bNNrgNvSyWf4Q1DuaDONzMAf_Pig.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL25ld3NsZXR0ZXItMTEuMDguMjMiLCJyIjoiMGU1ZjE4ZmEtMGY5Ny00ZWRkLWIzZTctMmVhOTQ4ZWEwZGFkIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)
---
| | |
---
| | National Battleground: Dayton, Washington, Columbia County
---
| | In a twist that has thrust Dayton into the national spotlight, its public library faced closure, marking it as the first in the nation to have grappled with the threat of shutting its doors due to book censorship. The attempt to close the library stems from a minority of residents advocating the radicalized extremist MAGA ideology, showcasing a clash that brings attention to the complexities and vulnerabilities of our legal system ([CrossCut](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0aOrMcET_/c?w=vSXqNaTFZ0FE-cd9xwUiVBMHBPmCYkhqTJShJe1Si3w.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9jcm9zc2N1dC5jb20vYnJpZWZzLzIwMjMvMDkvY291cnQtYmxvY2tzLWJhbGxvdC1tZWFzdXJlLWNsb3NlLXdhLXJ1cmFsLWxpYnJhcnktZGlzdHJpY3QiLCJyIjoiODA4MDM5N2YtNGRkNS00OTFiLTgzNWEtMTFiMTczOTE3NjMyIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)). The [Dayton Chronicle](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0aOrMcET_/c?w=8Zg2aefnb0eNDEcTvp5eWkF_VLMh4hEcJ85iezlEYGg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZGF5dG9uY2hyb25pY2xlLmNvbS9zdG9yeS8yMDIyLzA1LzE5L25ld3MvbmV3bHktZm9ybWVkLXBhYy1zdXBwb3J0cy1wcm9ncmVzcy8yOTYwLmh0bWwiLCJyIjoiODA4MDM5N2YtNGRkNS00OTFiLTgzNWEtMTFiMTczOTE3NjMyIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) reveals the formation of the Columbia County-based non-profit [Neighbors United for Progress](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0aOrMcET_/c?w=oC-ByGm1lpH_rwRGH5a4Yh2PLi92_B4cFuMA47vd3TA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL25laWdoYm9yc3VuaXRlZGZvcnByb2dyZXNzIiwiciI6IjgwODAzOTdmLTRkZDUtNDkxYi04MzVhLTExYjE3MzkxNzYzMiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) (NUP) in 2022. NUP emerged to address various concerns within their communities, demonstrating a commitment to safeguarding local assets like the public library.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/0aOrMcET_/c?w=ll8KR3caA7-RfrkL2_fpq5ZPraa3DvZoJrSwBaKiPBc.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL25laWdoYm9yc3VuaXRlZGZvcnByb2dyZXNzIiwiciI6ImEyOTUyOThmLWE3MTUtNGI2Ny1kOGUxLWNlM2ZlMzljZjA4NCIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)

| | NUP swiftly mobilized community support and took legal action by filing a lawsuit to prevent the library's potential closure from reaching the November 2023 ballot. | More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

body:
I'm under no illusions. |
---
| | Here's my Monday motivation, Peter. This race isn't just about flipping our CA-47 Congressional seat red.

**It's about saving our great country**... which requires electing Republicans who are _serious_ about _seriously_ leading with the urgency America desperately needs.

_**...S**_ _erious_**about** _serious**l**_** _y_ securing our border** and putting an end to Biden's open border lawlessness.

**_...Serious_ about **_**seriously** _**cutting spending** and reversing our out-of-control federal debt and inflation crisis.

**_...Serious_ about _seriously_** **protecting our schools** and saving the next generation of American children from far Left political indoctrination and ideological experimentation.

I'm under no illusions that these priorities will be easy. But here's the thing: **_we won't win any of these fights if we don't elect leaders who have the courage to try._**

[**> >> **](https://maxforoc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0d5d4fbfb4ace920581f6c90d&id=58fa9ca104&e=86e91e802d)[**That's why I'm asking great pro-America patriots like you to ENDORSE my campaign for Congress TODAY.**](https://maxforoc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0d5d4fbfb4ace920581f6c90d&id=3f8e59686e&e=86e91e802d)

I'm not running for Congress to be a wallflower or a yes man obsessed with re-election.

I'm running to fight for Orange County and our country and treat my first term in Congress with the same urgency like it's my last.

[If you’ve been on Team Ritchie from day 1, you can click here to skip my story and support our grassroots movement »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77987135/452058374/-866719404?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240129_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZGViNDM4My1kZGJlLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sTRKW1oFbWroJLZ-bZptcZ2AYpXK0ZXWE90SK64A7hY=)

🏳️🌈 I’m the first openly LGBTQ+ Afro-Latino man in Congress. My lived experience as a gay Black man motivates me to fight _every day_ until we are fully equal in the eyes of the law.

👊🏽 I’m a tireless advocate for Social Security and Medicare. I believe proper health care cannot be limited to physical health, and I’ll continue to advocate tirelessly for access to mental health care.
