[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=8fd3a541da&e=567664f14c)

We're excited to share the [latest episode](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=a84329de90&e=567664f14c) of the No Doubt About It podcast with Mark and, this time, special guest Darren White, former Bernalillo County Sheriff.

[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=0fe4ee9f43&e=567664f14c)
In this episode, Mark and Darren dive into what is fast becoming a significant scandal at the Albuquerque Police Department. The FBI is accusing five officers of taking bribes from defense lawyers to skip testifying at DWI hearings. Darren shares insights, predicting that this scandal will only grow larger. Both Mark and Darren make a strong case for the resignation of APD Police Chief Harold Medina.
| [STREAM NEW EPISODE NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=3a6e3637f0&e=567664f14c)
---

The conversation then shifts to the Biden administration's miserable failure at the border, a topic causing frustration even among fellow Democrats like Hillary Clinton. Biden's horrendous handling of the situation will cost him in the 2024 presidential race against Donald Trump.

Most importantly, we discuss the likelihood of a terror attack because of the Biden Administration’s policy to let everyone possible into the country even those who come from countries who want to do us harm. Are we living on borrowed time before an attack? It sure seems that way according to people like Ted Cruz. Mark and Darren offer their thoughts.
| [STREAM NEW EPISODE NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=970c6f7b10&e=567664f14c)
---
Finally, the episode concludes with a bizarre story involving three people found dead in their friend's backyard after a Kansas City Chiefs football game.
Please consider supporting us by liking, subscribing, and leaving a review on your preferred podcast platform. Don't forget to [subscribe to our YouTube channel](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=151180d04f&e=567664f14c) for more content.

For those who want to contribute financially or grab some exclusive podcast gear, visit [nodoubtaboutitpodcast.com](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=6f9fc1df93&e=567664f14c).

Thank you for being an essential part of our community, and we look forward to having you tune in and share your thoughts on these lively topics!
Best Regards,Mark and Krysty Ronchetti

body:

---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4a42415739da41e59df47029ce6a140c&_e=5ZvnbNkzsRl3Nz_vyuntlw6Ii6Sv_PCFGBbRAAQq_4sTIP0ST2NO22RmMVZbwSanmkujo9xeD2dvQfv2eXpx9gP8uClF5WB1c2QrSvkCWJmmQdPlNex2UTIRHbAinvfR797aB_LGVWBYnk84Z9G_swhuU_y0MiOdousmmE4HvyolvPPer7SA2OThL5VIYgCB3UDvhdFxkFdjc5MQka9DKtFS3tSseESzn8DTyJPzjftNtqug0vKCD8K-1antCHuj0MiPQwTPb8UWlgtY66uBe1vYiSuKTsxbKDaZF-Zh4a6NIdoax77H7eIA8oxCb0j9t_snSbPekfCjv5aVVl_aid0Zfedty3_ttoDkz2R0t7G5CmLrg7MccJwlUEQQb3aMzEgp2hBj0Nvv8fxtXGzr0g%3D%3D)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. body:
Sinema spent $200k of your tax money on private flights | | | Peter – What’s that? Is it a bird? Superman?? Nope! It’s Kyrsten Sinema’s private plane! [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zNlHUaTRqcaJjXHZRzAn_iG56hFzicDSJJTWm-ftLtvnRZMeLDEP9Qmr6mY4MAQ1x2bsOHT36EyZiQ8E4hPsG8bWQy9_bXz25gGBeY1_jNcQL0i6RrjiTvoCA5LtWfxXCJq32GD7NVkKDjHfZwK7J3Tca29UFuEiWNYEoQYJQSqCJx_yqgJBwoT5QmR_pELPKUOQvIU29zgoXbK4m81r5Cabbf1aXc0dNfQJSORUvhBoMxxcwPtoWJ9dQmzNwd2c-cjjRs_V_q1M3DUOfHepWd1Z3Nxck36JRARjgzvuWyPgRq4Sz7qThBe8WbQRbd66tUdaC3pa8wL3ZkkF7PWipO4f3j8NE10scgvsuLxHQpejjFfVtjWk-pub_dE7VvmDbyO7uzHgmkiqOWHLGbyn7Z/43e/4dsDCdNfRvyhKRiRB0MZlA/h0/hI2_V-y3cn_kb6c_9l4pLHssIZWmiuZJeoDGPXCRNho) Today the Daily Beast details Kyrsten Sinema spent over $200,000 in taxpayer dollars to charter private flights. And most of that was in just the last year – private flights to cover distances that were either easily drivable (like Phoenix to Flagstaff) or that normal people would fly commercial (like from DC to Arizona). | | Dear friends, I’m writing to let you know that in this year’s U.S. Senate primary election, I’ll be enthusiastically supporting Congressman Andy Kim. As New Jersey Democrats, we have a weighty responsibility this year. We’re choosing a United States Senator at a moment when the world is on fire and our democracy is in danger. We’re replacing a Senator who — before he lost our trust — exercised huge authority as chairman of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee and as a fighter for New Jersey’s interests. Our next Senator must be a person who is prepared from day one to rise to the challenges our nation faces — from the wars in Ukraine to Gaza to the threat of a Trump victory. Our next Senator must be a leader who restores integrity to the office while maintaining its influence; someone who leaves behind the corruption of Bob Menendez, with no loss of clout. Andy Kim has all the qualities we should be seeking in these difficult times. He is a person of unquestionable character who clearly has the experience to be an effective Senator. He has spent his whole career in public service, as a member of Congress and as a national security official in the Obama administration. I worked closely with Andy during my years at the State Department, and as part of the class of Democrats who flipped the House in 2018. Time and again, I’ve seen him do the right thing, even when it was hard. He truly has earned the opportunity to represent us — and he’s done so in all the right ways. How we choose our Senate nominee this year also matters. Given the stakes, I’m confident that the number one consideration for primary voters will be to pick the person best qualified to fight for us in Washington. That should be the only consideration for leaders in our party, too. Official party endorsements carry a lot of weight in primaries in our state, and that’s fine. But they should be guided by the values and views of Democratic voters. I’ve spoken to countless Democrats over the last few weeks about the Senate race — including many of the folks who knocked on doors to get me elected to the House. The great majority are enthusiastic about Andy’s campaign and about what it represents. Especially after what happened with Bob Menendez, they want a process that reflects well on our state. That’s why Andy is leading in the polls. It's why I'm confident he’s on his way to winning this race. This is a time for New Jersey Democrats to put our best foot forward, and to elect a good man who can be a great United States Senator. **[I hope you will join me in backing Andy.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77991724/452073112/899321571?refcode=EM_NBI_DFD_20240129_FR_NoteFromTom/Kim1.3_0_Tom_NA_NA&refcode2=d4626646-e7be-ee11-b660-002248223197&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNDYyNjY0Ni1lN2JlLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-gnXlf7Qtt8v79mFwztCXHZ4YXi8ewp0u2Ow3gLjh50=&emci=66afc090-d8be-ee11-b660-002248223197&emdi=d4626646-e7be-ee11-b660-002248223197&ceid=19214294)** Thank you as always, Tom Malinowski

Have I ever told you how I got into public service?

**I grew up the son of hardworking farmworkers.** My family lived in a small trailer in rural California where my brother and I shared a bed that in the daytime converted into a kitchen table.

When I was a teenager, I walked in the desert heat to different businesses asking them to invest in our community by investing in me and my dreams of a college education. I made them a promise that I would come back to the Coachella Valley to serve our community as a physician in return for their trust in me.

I not only returned to serve as an emergency physician, but eventually was elected to serve my community in Congress. For more than a decade, I’ve fought every day for my family, friends, and neighbors who dream the same dream my parents had for me.

**Those memories have come flooding back lately.** Because I’ve spent entirely too much time listening to the MAGA circus go round after round, attacking each other, blaming Democrats, and doing everything they can _EXCEPT_ serving the American people.

**And that’s part and parcel for the extreme MAGA caucus.** Instead of doing the hard work of reaching across the aisle to build consensus, they grind our government to a halt to play partisan games.

Instead of building progress and promise for the next generation of Americans, they desperately scratch and claw their way to their own power, everyone else be damned. **They’re not public servants – they only serve themselves, and I’m sick of it.**

**They need to get their house in order. They need to end the chaos. They need to do their jobs. But I’m not waiting around for them, team, I’m taking action.**

clean_body: | = = Folks, Have I ever told you how I got into public service? I grew up the son of hardworking farmworkers. My family lived in a small trailer in rural California where my brother and I shared a bed that in the daytime converted into a kitchen table. When I was a teenager, I walked in the desert heat to different businesses asking them to invest in our community by investing in me and my dreams of a college education. I made them a promise that I would come back to the Coachella Valley to serve our community as a physician in return for their trust in me. I not only returned to serve as an emergency physician, but eventually was elected to serve my community in Congress. For more than a decade, I’ve fought every day for my family, friends, and neighbors who dream the same dream my parents had for me. Those memories have come flooding back lately. Because I’ve spent entirely too much time listening to the MAGA circus go round after round, attacking each other, blaming Democrats, and doing everything they can EXCEPT serving the American people. And that’s part and parcel for the extreme MAGA caucus. Instead of doing the hard work of reaching across the aisle to build consensus, they grind our government to a halt to play partisan games. Instead of building progress and promise for the next generation of Americans, they desperately scratch and claw their way to their own power, everyone else be damned. They’re not public servants – they only serve themselves, and I’m sick of it. They need to get their house in order. They need to end the chaos. They need to do their jobs. A wide open border is leading criminals, drug dealers, and suspected terrorists right into our country.

The American economy is getting leveled and our currency is shorting out.

Friend, the left wants you to think that you’re crazy. They want you to think that nobody else notices that Biden’s leadership is destroying our country. But I notice, and millions of others do, too.

Things in our country aren’t ok, Bidenomics isn’t working, and our border isn’t secure. That’s the truth, no matter how much the Biden Administration lies to us.
**[That’s why I’m running for the U.S. Senate.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=b3fce50a0c3b4916992898f66597b891&_e=SGRmTEgW8zYv6rxRmPLLYZtLKytrbV6oqxgmhECO-7bpByW6bRGUAPgNtpWqTlWr8lzPTkx8NiSYdvBOCcwLOztT270B2wE9tcVv6pQKNoX9TGaZsBmL8IB9sYg2bJgEWC34PtSZGZ7Nz3XPh9kJZHFsbZlyydXTYzSN2FCQDHz077SE4QTO4_nuYRrZmxKnzkTwmRqs6fJDxw1MjgVArd_V_BPsmSwwwUpTpehim7UavhowvGeAS4x2IcHj_nMAeGe5Sbt8XPr2p-TGjqrLyX-AhuMhrzWN9whx6m7jNYyht1m-Hl1teqFJ2MNSZvqKv-H3fGSCzahMWx8_vBYoHCeR8fOkB18MzVbwcECcTSdNo3PAVBRqyztbRRJqt3Unfb_SZ_Gnl5n2h6b5Mf9yMg%3D%3D)** When I left Congress in 2015, I thought I’d never run for office again.

But I’m sick and tired of the lies, of the corruption, and of the fervent denial that our country is in a dangerous place.

So I’m stepping up to do something about it.**
** **[ Call me old fashioned, but I still believe that government officials should conduct themselves with honesty, integrity, and a strong moral character.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=b3fce50a0c3b4916992898f66597b891&_e=SGRmTEgW8zYv6rxRmPLLYZtLKytrbV6oqxgmhECO-7bpByW6bRGUAPgNtpWqTlWr8lzPTkx8NiSYdvBOCcwLOztT270B2wE9tcVv6pQKNoX9TGaZsBmL8IB9sYg2bJgEWC34PtSZGZ7Nz3XPh9kJZHFsbZlyydXTYzSN2FCQDHz077SE4QTO4_nuYRrZmxKnzkTwmRqs6fJDxw1MjgVArd_V_BPsmSwwwUpTpehim7UavhowvGeAS4x2IcHj_nMAXB8iS76yVMHpVTfXVRkWf53rREp9nnnm8mv1srbcDUOuk3Z8Zggf-UpZdsmc46dGNIxiXv2JIk_xsbxL1RqOIK9xsSdaaaWMlrZ1XIjbZXEeHF_DMkA-2ohpVQuUBx6J5fafhPPh4zCg4ZMXBawtLg%3D%3D)** And you can be assured that when I get elected, I’ll be an advocate for **YOU** , against the dishonest voices in D.C. that are selling you fake narratives.

The dishonest Democrats are terrified of what I’ll do when I get to Washington, which is why they’ve already pledged millions of dollars to defeat me.

But with the help of grassroots patriots like yourself, we’ll stand up to their lies and smears to usher in a new era of American greatness. **
** So, Friend, **[**can I count on your help?**](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=b3fce50a0c3b4916992898f66597b891&_e=SGRmTEgW8zYv6rxRmPLLYZtLKytrbV6oqxgmhECO-7bpByW6bRGUAPgNtpWqTlWr8lzPTkx8NiSYdvBOCcwLOztT270B2wE9tcVv6pQKNoX9TGaZsBmL8IB9sYg2bJgEWC34PtSZGZ7Nz3XPh9kJZHFsbZlyydXTYzSN2FCQDHz077SE4QTO4_nuYRrZmxKnzkTwmRqs6fJDxw1MjgVArd_V_BPsmSwwwUpTpehim7UavhowvGeAS4x2IcHj_nMAPkAXjRkXwuIu_qD6NSSvYxx6kps_gXFN0vm9sRdeGjSedQ-eoUaSdoOEj4OMAyXp72IyUaINvQEQmpdcyDDDC4pwxXCdRD0Xezj4KrAoZrfqrhhaTPjdwFmCWwl9uDJrezyOLJ2TWlFdGVBjPSfnfw%3D%3D)** This election will be **CRUCIAL** to deciding the Senate majority and I’ll need all the help I can get.

Mike Rogers**

name: Nikki Haley
subject: Moment to talk?
body:
I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/bNdtYM1QW8OFpli_9aO84Q~~/AARclAA~~)
---

Friend,

Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/bNdtYM1QW8OFpli_9aO84Q~~/AARclAA~~ "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
---
| | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/bNdtYM1QW8OFpli_9aO84Q~~/AARclAA~~)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**
---
| | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/bNdtYM1QW8OFpli_9aO84Q~~/AARclAA~~)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/bNdtYM1QW8OFpli_9aO84Q~~/AARclAA~~)
---

Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person _reading this today_ could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/bNdtYM1QW8OFpli_9aO84Q~~/AARclAA~~ "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/bNdtYM1QW8OFpli_9aO84Q~~/AARclAA~~ "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?")**

---

clean_body: | | | | | | Fellow American, That's the day of the California primary. The top two go head-to-head in November. I can think of only one thing worse than a General Election ballot that forces Californians to "choose" between three dyed-in-the-wool leftists like Schiff, Porter, or Lee... ...and that's being forced to endure six years of Schiff, Porter, or Lee in the U.S. Senate. I need your help to go "three up...three down" against this lineup of liberal career politicians. That's a bit of baseball vernacular. No surprise, right? It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning. Then, it's your team's turn to go on offense. Well, that's very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country. Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years - most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I'm reaching out to you today. Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California. Think about the daily reality of: • Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California. • Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don't lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction. If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a "false choice" between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, Winning this election requires a one-two punch: 1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign "connecting the dots" between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day. In my playing days, I would never be out-worked or out-hustled. That's my approach to this campaign. Door-knocks, phone-calls, rallies, townhalls, you name it. With you on our side, I'm confident we can not only give voters a real choice, but someone who remembers how great California was and knows how great it can be again. | | With deepest appreciation, Steve Garvey Republican for United States Senate | | | | | | | MY VISION My campaign is focused on quality-of-life issues, public safety, and education. As your U.S. Senator, I will serve with commonsense, compassion, and will work to build consensus to benefit all of the people of California. I've been fortunate to wear many hats in life - from professional athlete to businessman to philanthropist. But the one thing that has remained consistent is my love for this great state and my desire to make a difference. In baseball, it's not about the individual; it's about the team. I believe the same holds true for politics. It's time we come together, find common ground, and work towards a brighter future. | | | | PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE 9070 Irvine Center Drive, Suite 150 Irvine, CA 92618 | | This Email was Sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com If you would like to stop recieving our emails ****_ |

Folks, We are hard at work building a grassroots movement strong enough to protect Nikki’s seat and keep her fighting in Congress. Everyday, more folks join in to help power our fight, so we wanted to pause from our typical emails to share a few facts about Nikki beyond her steadfast work to make progress for families, farmers, and veterans across our country:
1. Nikki’s nephew Noah, is an athlete and played basketball at the the Special Olympics — she recently introduced the _Down Syndrome Diagnosis Act_ in the House to help every family get the support they need to navigate this diagnosis.

2. Nikki’s preferred drink of choice is diet Dr. Pepper, and she can often be found carrying one with her on her travels across the districts from Champaign to Metro East.

3. Nikki is a proud graduate of University of Illinois and supports her alma mater’s basketball and football teams — _even through the more difficult seasons!!_

| Holy sh*t, Peter:

**Bob Casey’s mega-millionaire opponent, David McCormick, outraised him by millions. But that’s just the tip of the iceberg...**

McCormick put in $1 million of his own personal fortune AND a super PAC supporting him announced that it raised a RECORD-BREAKING $18 million last year.

When I heard this, I nearly blew a gasket.

With that kind of money, McCormick and national Republicans can flood the airwaves with attack ads, wallpaper the Commonwealth with yard signs, get boots on the ground early, AND have cash to spare.

In a battleground like Pennsylvania, that could be the difference between winning and losing. There’s simply no way we keep the Senate without PA. That’s just a fact. So we’ve got to rally behind Bob now to ensure that he’s got the resources he needs to take on the wall of dark money headed his way.

name: David Horowitz
subject: Barack Obama’s revolution
body:
Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/DeLvd7bWGKXs06eNRgRO5w~~/AARclAA~/RgRnmq4EP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9kYXZpZC1ob3Jvd2l0ei1mcmVlZG9tLWNlbnRlci9kZDMwZDdhMS0yOTI1LTRmZGEtOWY1Zi1hNWExZjA0OTg1NTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMTI5X0JER19ESEZDX09CRTJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgplszMeuGXoezVVUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/DeLvd7bWGKXs06eNRgRO5w~~/AARclAA~/RgRnmq4EP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9kYXZpZC1ob3Jvd2l0ei1mcmVlZG9tLWNlbnRlci9kZDMwZDdhMS0yOTI1LTRmZGEtOWY1Zi1hNWExZjA0OTg1NTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMTI5X0JER19ESEZDX09CRTJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgplszMeuGXoezVVUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

David Horowitz

Keir will always fight for fairness, opportunity and justice. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | = Peter, the Pennsylvania Supreme Court just handed down a major ruling that will impact 1 in 6 Pennsylvanians: PA Medicaid should cover the cost of abortion. Importantly, several justices indicated they were ready to recognize abortion access as a right in the state’s constitution — because while abortion is legal in PA, it is NOT protected by the constitution and not everyone has equal access to the care they need when they need it. Understanding that difference matters a LOT in the race to become your next Attorney General. = | | = Let me be VERY clear about my position on abortion: Abortion care is health care. Politicians are not doctors. And the right to make decisions about your own body is yours — and yours alone. But let me also make clear that as the only Black woman in this race, my reasons for protecting a woman’s right to choose are different from my opponents. Abortion bans increase both health AND financial risks for those seeking care — which means it also disproportionately impacts poor women and Black women in this state and across the country. About 25% of women will have an abortion in their lifetime — 60% of those women are already mothers. 59% of women seeking abortions are mothers facing high poverty risk. 40% of women who get abortions in the U.S. are Black. Not only do Attorneys General interpret and enforce the law, they are responsible for providing accurate information to residents about what types of abortion care is legal. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: The Lions
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
Please respect Michigan’s privacy today
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1079%2E135344%2EID6z3Q)

Friend,
There’s truly nothing like sports—the way a game can make (or ruin) your whole week or month, the instant connection when you spot someone wearing your team’s jersey in the wild, and the absolute elation that comes when things finally come together after a tough decade, or perhaps a few tough decades. It’s a joy (and right now, a pain) like no other.
This Detroit Lions team was something special. Their motto for this season, “All Grit,” summed up not just the team, but the city and state that they represent. Even in a heartbreaking NFC Championship, this team has embodied the passion, determination, and kick-ass mentality that defines Michiganders.
I know I’ll be proudly rocking this vintage jacket from 1952 (the last time they won the championship) all off-season.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-jan24.--Kpen&refcode=em240129-2-15&t=2&akid=1079%2E135344%2EID6z3Q)
Through their run, this Lions team brought us together as a state. The last time I can remember feeling like this was when I was in middle school. It was 1988, and the Pistons had nearly won the NBA Championship the previous season, narrowly losing Game 6 on a controversial foul call. They went on to become back-to-back champions, winning in the 1988-1989 season and the 1989-1990 season. That was the era of Bad Boys, so-named for “don’t-ever-back down mentality.” Sound familiar?
I’ve got a good feeling that these Detroit Lions, like the Bad Boy Pistons of the late 80s, will be back.
A lot has changed since 1990 here in Michigan and around the world, but the sense of community, joy, and pure magic around our beloved home teams hasn’t changed.
#OnePride forever.
Elissa

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Today, Jamaal Bowman’s AIPAC-endorsed primary opponent George Latimer
announced he’s raised nearly $1.4 million in less than a month since
launching his campaign. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240129-2-jb.T1tt-M&refcode=em20240129-33069&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1001&akid=33069%2E1203867%2E9VOHjY ]Can you rush a split contribution to help us
fight back?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240129-2-jb.T1tt-M&refcode=em20240129-33069&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=33069%2E1203867%2E9VOHjY ]Jewish Insider: George Latimer announces huge fundraising haul in
campaign against Rep. Bowman. The Westchester County executive raised
nearly $1.4 million in the fourth quarter of 2023

That’s a lot of money for Jamaal and our grassroots movement to go up
against, and it’s only just beginning. AIPAC — who’s preparing to spend
$100 million against the Squad this year — officially endorsed Latimer
last week, and Democratic Majority for Israel is already sending
fundraising emails on his behalf.

The right-wing, anti-Palestinian lobby is preparing to drop massive
amounts of money into this competitive primary between now and June to
unseat Jamaal for his progressive leadership and support for a ceasefire.
But with enough people power, we can stop them and keep Jamaal fighting
for us in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240129-2-jb.T1tt-M&refcode=em20240129-33069&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1003&akid=33069%2E1203867%2E9VOHjY ]With January rapidly coming to a close in just two days, will you split
a grassroots donation of $3 or more to support Justice
Democrats and Jamaal’s campaign before our end-of-month fundraising
deadline?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240129-2-jb.T1tt-M&refcode=em20240129-33069&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1022&akid=33069%2E1203867%2E9VOHjY ]Contribute $3

Thanks for anything you can give towards re-electing Jamaal and defending
our progressive bloc.

Geoff Simpson
Campaigns Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1023&akid=33069%2E1203867%2E9VOHjY ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1024&akid=33069%2E1203867%2E9VOHjY ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

body:
Libraries should be for education, exploration, and discovery — not banning books. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77998486/452094971/1954656641?refcode=EM_FL_MCB_20240129_fr_alabama_cand_nc_natl_a_hdr&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjI0OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYTVmYTg3ZC1mN2JlLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ENuUr4LW9Hxn8ABMsidR3mckr_ZcG1OeuKKLYq9NGn4=)
---
**What do Amish romance novels, very popular science fiction books, and a picture book about my first campaign all have in common?** _(I swear, this isn’t a bad set up for a joke.)_ The Alabama Public Library Service is "reviewing" all of them for possible removal from public libraries across the state. The private reception with RFK, Jr. will include Jackson Hole’s finest wine and most delicious bites. Join us for a special Q&A session and get your picture with the future President!
[Detroit, Michigan](https://www.kennedy24.com/detroit-reception?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_newsletter_1_29_24_1nd&n=7) \- Saturday, February 10th at 6:30 PM

You’re invited to an unforgettable virtual experience featuring Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. alongside a special guest for an engaging fireside chat, providing insights into RFK, Jr.'s vision for the future of our nation.
[Newport Beach, California](https://www.kennedy24.com/newport-reception?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_newsletter_1_29_24_1nd&n=10) \- Saturday, February 24th at 7:30 PM
Join us at a private venue in the heart of Newport Beach for a special event. Experience an intimate Q&A session with RFK, Jr. while enjoying hors d'oeuvres, cocktails, and memorable photo opportunities.

Despite running this campaign on a shoestring budget, thanks to your support we’ve built a 50-state coalition. Your donations are helping me get on the ballot in all 50 states and the District of Columbia so that I can continue on the path to victory all the way to the White House.

Friend,
You know Dan Campbell, the coach of the Detroit Lions. The Lions had an incredible season this year, defying expectations and making it to the NFC Championship game.
While they fell short of the ultimate victory, their remarkable journey was more than football; it was a story of tenacity, resilience, and the indomitable grit of one great state.
Last night, a constituent mentioned that Bob and Coach Campbell share a striking resemblance in at least one picture. However, not just their appearance connects them; it's their shared commitment to overcoming adversity and their unwavering belief in progress and development.
After the primary, this will be Dr. Bob's second time facing corporate-funded incumbent, Rep. Jack Bergman.
Success doesn't happen overnight, not in one season, and often not in the first election cycle.
Success takes time, dedication, and the loyalty of supporters. With your help, the combined efforts of a repeat candidate, ballot name recognition, and unyielding momentum, we can push Bob forward down the field to a historic victory.
In the last cycle, considering redistricting, Bob moved the needle for Democrats by more than five points. Similarly, keeping faith in Coach Campbell since 2021 helped the Lions achieve a divisional title.
To continue to change the tide, not be set backward, and secure a better future for all, Doc needs your grassroots support [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] now more than ever.
Thank you for standing in our corner.
Onward,
Margaret

| Hi Peter,

I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself: I’m Sarah Carlson, and I am Laura Gillen’s campaign manager.
